jobs.title: Enterprise Transformation Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Position Summary:**  
Leads the planning and execution of Penn Foster Group's enterprise migration of partners and learners from a legacy platform to the company's newest technology stack. Coordinates technical, operational, and change management work across teams and partners, keeping stakeholders informed, resolving blockers, and managing readiness through migration, cutover, and stabilization. Brings strong technical understanding, careful attention to detail, and experience delivering large, complex change initiatives.
  
  
**Essential Job Functions:**  

* Coordinates the migration of partner and learner populations from legacy platforms to Penn Foster Group's newest technology stack, aligning scope, cohorts, sequencing, readiness, cutover, and stabilization.
* Maintains an integrated plan of milestones, owners, dependencies, risks, decisions, and blockers; communicates progress, impacts, and needed actions to key stakeholders.
* Translates legacy processes and partner needs into detailed technical and operational requirements for target-state systems, integrations, workflows, and configurations; works closely with IT, Product, Operations, and partner teams.
* Coordinates data, content, program, and assessment mapping and validation; leads test planning, user acceptance testing, reconciliation, and readiness reviews to confirm accurate migration outcomes.
* Leads change management and transition planning with partners and internal teams, including communications, training, support readiness, and learner continuity.
* Drives cross-functional issue resolution and decisions, removes blockers, manages risks and exceptions, and coordinates cutover and contingency plans.
* Monitors migration quality and post-launch outcomes, including data and enrollment accuracy, defects, partner and learner impacts, and support needs; resolves root causes and improves migration standards for subsequent waves.

**Knowledge, Skills, Abilities:**  

* Experience leading complex implementations, migrations, integrations, or partner launches from intake through launch and stabilization.
* Experience partnering with IT and developers on integrations, data flows, system configuration, enhancements, and migrations.
* Knowledge of test planning, user acceptance testing, defect triage, launch readiness, deployment coordination, and support after launch.
* Strong project management skills across scope, timelines, dependencies, risks, decisions, follow-ups, and stakeholder communication.
* Analytical problem-solving and root cause analysis across enrollment, configuration, billing, reporting, and workflow issues; distinguishes one-time exceptions from systemic problems.
* Process improvement skills, including designing scalable workflows, dashboards, self-service resources, procedures, and repeatable standards.
* Clear written and verbal communication, documentation, and facilitation skills with internal teams and external partners.

**Working Conditions & Hiring Process:**  

* U.S. Work Location Requirement: All employees must reside in and perform work within the United States. We do not support international remote work arrangements for this role.
* Travel Expectations: While this is a remote position, occasional travel may be required for team meetings, company events, conferences, summits, etc. Candidates must be willing and able to travel as needed.
* On-Camera Work Environment: We operate in a highly collaborative, remote, on-camera culture. Employees are expected to be on camera during meetings unless extenuating circumstances apply.
* Recorded Video Interviews: All video interviews conducted during the hiring process will be recorded to support internal hiring consistency and process improvement.
* Background Checks: Employment with Penn Foster Group is contingent upon successfully completing applicable pre-employment screening requirements, which may include verification of employment history, education, and criminal background, where permitted by law.
* Identity Verification (Form I-9): As part of our onboarding process, all hires must complete employment eligibility verification in compliance with federal law. This includes remote Form I-9 verification, which may require an in-person identity verification step with an authorized representative.

**About Us:**  
At Penn Foster Group, we are transforming online learning to help learners by uniting Penn Foster, CareerStep, Ashworth College, James Madison High School, the New York Institute of Photography, the New York Institute of Art and Design, and other education platforms. Together, we create an accelerated path to greater economic mobility through real-world skills and knowledge that enable them to achieve long-term success in the workplaces of the future. Our history dates back to 1890 when our founder, Thomas Foster, pioneered distance education by offering training by mail for coal miners to get the necessary skills for safer jobs. Today, with the partners who use our education and training programs, we continue that mission of providing accessible training and education for in-demand skills and are building a workforce that’s prepared for the future job market.
  
  
**Equal Employment Opportunity:**  
We strive toward Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Penn Foster Group by intentionally building teams that are diverse – in identities, lived experiences, and ideas to create a culture where people feel connected to each other and have a sense of belonging. We value diversity, equity, and inclusion because it is the foundation that enables us to achieve what we set out to do as an organization – from maximizing the number of learners who can reach their goals while giving them the kinds of experiences we want them to have, to becoming the type of company we want to work in.

jobs.title: Commercial Program Manager
jobs.description:
At IEM, we're not just building innovative electrical distribution systems, we're shaping the future. IEM is dedicated to delivering world-class solutions for complex power needs. After 75 years, we continue to push the boundaries of what's possible. Whether you're an experienced professional or just starting out, you'll have the opportunity to contribute, grow, and make a lasting impact on industries that power the world's most dynamic markets.

**Location:** Jacksonville, FL

**Reports To:** Director Global Accounts Executive

**Salary Range:** $115,000-$165,000

**Position Summary:**

We are a rapidly expanding manufacturing company focused on delivering complex, high-volume solutions for leading enterprise customers. Our success is built on operational excellence, strategic partnerships, and an unwavering commitment to innovation and customer satisfaction. We are seeking a professional, proactive, and strategic **Commercial Program Manager** to lead and manage the partnership with one of our most critical enterprise customers.

The **Commercial Program Manager** is responsible for managing the full program lifecycle, ensuring alignment between customer demand and internal production capabilities. This role is accountable for aligning internal operations with client requirements, ensuring timely delivery, quality performance, and seamless execution across all phases of the program. The ideal candidate is a proactive, strategic thinker with strong program management experience and the ability to coordinate across diverse internal teams and external stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Proactively review and interpret customer forecasts to identify trends, anticipate demand shifts, and align supplier capacity and internal production schedules accordingly.
* Translate forecast data into actionable plans by working directly with production teams to coordinate build output and ensure readiness for deployment.
* Own the process for correcting purchase orders, reconciling discrepancies, and coordinating timely pricing updates between internal teams and the customer
* Respond quickly to quality and field service issues, coordinating internally to drive resolutions and minimize customer impact.
* Actively contribute to customer related projects and continuous improvement initiatives that increase efficiency and enhance customer satisfaction.
* Ensure program delivery aligns with customer service level agreements by constantly monitoring performance metrics and taking corrective action as needed.
* Take a data-driven approach to aligning inventory with forecasted demand and support planning for body of design, product phaseouts, and lifecycle transitions.
* Analyze volume trends and program data to inform decision-making, highlight risks, and support continuous improvement in delivery performance.
* Monitor inventory levels closely, perform flow analysis, and take corrective actions to prevent shortages or excess while maintaining alignment with customer demand.
* Foster a culture of team accountability and collaborative problem-solving across departments by setting clear expectations, following up on deliverables, and driving shared program goals forward.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in business, Engineering or related field (MBA or PMP certification a plus).
* 5+ years of program or project management experience in a manufacturing or enterprise client-facing role with annualized volume exceeding $10 million.
* Proven track record managing complex programs with multiple stakeholders across technical and business functions.
* Strong understanding of supply chain processes, inventory management, and demand planning.
* Experience with ERP and customer portal tools.
* Excellent organizational, analytical, and communication skills.
* Demonstrated ability to work under pressure, prioritize tasks, and drive results across functional boundaries.
* Comfortable managing ambiguity and adapting to a dynamic, high-growth environment.
* Exceptional interpersonal skills with a collaborative, team-first mentality.

**Why Join IEM**

At IEM, you'll join a team that powers some of the world's most ambitious projects. We're engineers, makers, and problem-solvers who thrive on tackling complex challenges and delivering solutions that keep industries moving forward. If you're driven, collaborative, and ready to make an impact, we'd love to hear from you. Your creativity and passion can help us achieve great things—come be part of the journey.

Learn more about IEM at https://www.iemfg.com

We offer comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support our employees' well-being, growth, and long-term success. View a snapshot of our benefits at https://www.iemfg.com/careers

**Recruiting Scams**

Beware of recruiting scams. IEM never charges candidates fees, and all recruiter emails come from an @iemfg.com address. If you suspect fraudulent activity, do not share personal information and report it to us at iemfg.com/contact

Improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?

**Transform the everyday with us!**

**About Smart Infrastructure – Electrification and Automation:**

The Electrification and Automation (EA) Business Unit offers the full range of energy distribution systems and solutions for all markets and through all sales channels. We provide reliable power distribution grids of today while investing into our Future Grids portfolio and applications to create the power distribution grid of the future. Our comprehensive portfolio meets the growing technical requirements of today’s and tomorrow’s power grid!

**We are looking for a Project Manager. This position will be based in Prince George, VA.**

You will be responsible for the successful execution of projects, from project initiation through final closeout. You will work in a matrix style organization requiring excellent coordination skills and the ability to manage competing priorities. The PM role comes with ample opportunities for growth, reflective of Siemens’ mission to empower people with a growth mindset. This position will be initially based near a Siemens Partner facility in Prince George. Upon completion of this project (approximately 3-4 years) this position may transition into a remote role.

**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Lead internal contract manufacturing projects from inception through completion, managing scope, cost, schedule, quality, technical performance, milestones, and overall execution.
* Drive cross-functional collaboration across engineering, operations, procurement, supply chain, logistics, services, and the Contract Manufacturer to ensure successful project delivery.
* Oversee order management, procurement, forecasting, and material readiness, ensuring parts and components are available to support production schedules and customer demand.
* Proactively identify and resolve project, supply, material, schedule, and operational risks, including root-cause analysis, corrective actions, resource allocation, and mitigation planning.
* Serve as a key interface between Siemens teams and the Contract Manufacturer, providing clear communication on project status, priorities, demand, material availability, design changes, and emerging constraints.
* Coordinate engineering change management, documentation, process training, and continuous improvement, ensuring changes are effectively implemented and processes are consistently followed.
* Support overall site operations, including Siemens personnel and guest visits, employee onboarding and moves, IT/network access, engineering requirements, and on-site asset and maintenance planning.

**You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications:**

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited university or college
* 6+ years of experience in the power distribution industry managing medium voltage portfolios.
* 4+ years of experience utilizing Microsoft Office and specifically Microsoft Project
* 1+ year of working with multi-disciplinary teams, including program management, services, engineering, operations, and logistics
* Ability to travel up to 20% (domestic and international)
* Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship.
* PMP certification is required within 1 year of employment

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Factory /Order management experience is a plus for initial phase of this role.
* Bachelor’s degree in industrial, mechanical or electrical engineering
* Project management or related work experience in Power distribution industry.
* Project management or related work experience in manufacturing and /or production environment.
* Basic knowledge and understanding of power distribution; ability to read and understand basic electrical drawings and customer specifications.
* Experience working with contract manufacturing
* Experience in identifying and implementing cost savings measures within project
* Experience with technology knowledge transfer process
* Commitment to develop, drive, and manage projects in a highly competitive market
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, to present complex issues to multi-level audiences and effectively communicate progress, status and issues to internal and external Customers
* Ability to interpret and report results to senior management as well as customer
* Demonstrated ability in contract and change management across multiple departments and teams.
* Experience and certification with Lean manufacturing processes

We are a global technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, transport, and healthcare. From more resource-efficient factories, resilient supply chains, and smarter buildings and grids, to sustainable transportation as well as advanced healthcare, we create technology with purpose adding real value for customers. Learn more about Siemens here.

We value your unique identity and perspective. Forge (Emerald X) is seeking an experienced Senior Data Platform Project Manager / Agile Scrum Master to lead execution across our enterprise data platform and analytics portfolio. This role will provide project leadership and Scrum facilitation for the teams building and operating Forge's data foundation, including data ingestion and integration, data lakehouse and warehouse capabilities, master data, governance, semantic models, business intelligence, and reporting.

The role will lead initiatives from discovery and backlog definition through design, development, QA, user acceptance testing, deployment, and closeout. The successful candidate will bring structure, transparency, and delivery discipline to a cross-functional team of data engineers, architects, analysts, product owners, business stakeholders, and implementation partners. This is a hands-on delivery leadership role, not a data engineering role, but it requires sufficient technical fluency to understand data pipelines, integrations, cloud platforms, dependencies, and release risks.

The Senior Data Platform Project Manager / Agile Scrum Master will manage multiple concurrent initiatives, facilitate the Agile operating cadence, remove impediments, maintain delivery artifacts, and provide clear communication to both technical teams and senior business leaders.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end delivery of data platform, integration, analytics, and reporting initiatives from intake and discovery through production deployment and transition to support.
* Serve as Scrum Master and Agile delivery lead for the data platform team, promoting effective Agile practices and helping the team continuously improve delivery velocity, quality, and predictability.
* Facilitate backlog grooming, sprint planning, daily standups, technical design reviews, sprint reviews or demonstrations, retrospectives, and release-readiness activities.
* Partner with product owners and business stakeholders to define priorities, clarify requirements, establish acceptance criteria, sequence dependencies, and maintain a healthy, actionable backlog.
* Work with data engineers and technical leads to size user stories, plan sprint capacity, monitor progress, identify blockers, and keep commitments aligned with available resources.
* Build and maintain integrated project plans, roadmaps, milestones, RAID logs, RACI charts, stakeholder registers, decision logs, status reports, test plans, deployment checklists, and lessons learned.
* Coordinate cross-functional work across data engineering, application teams, enterprise architecture, security, infrastructure, business intelligence, data governance, vendors, and business functions.
* Manage delivery of cloud data-platform capabilities, including source ingestion, API and file-based integrations, data transformation, master data, data quality, governance, data models, and Power BI reporting.
* Coordinate structured QA and user acceptance testing, including test planning, business tester readiness, defect triage, evidence collection, sign-off, and readiness for production deployment.
* Ensure releases follow Forge change-management and deployment-governance requirements, with appropriate approvals, documentation, QA/UAT evidence, communications, and support transition.
* Identify delivery risks, resource constraints, scope changes, technical dependencies, and decision points early; drive resolution and escalate when necessary.
* Provide concise, audience-appropriate status reporting to project teams, business stakeholders, technology leadership, and executive sponsors.
* Promote consistent use of Jira and Confluence for user stories, acceptance criteria, sprint tracking, decisions, documentation, and delivery transparency.
* Support continuous improvement of Forge's data-delivery and PMO practices, balancing governance and accountability with practical, outcome-focused execution.

**Required Qualifications**

* 7+ years of project or program management experience delivering enterprise technology initiatives, including significant experience with data platforms, analytics, business intelligence, integration, or cloud-based systems.
* Demonstrated experience serving as an Agile Scrum Master or Agile Project Manager for data engineering, software development, analytics, or integration teams.
* Strong working knowledge of Scrum practices, including backlog management, user stories, acceptance criteria, estimation, sprint planning, standups, reviews, retrospectives, velocity, and impediment removal.
* Experience managing projects involving data ingestion, ETL/ELT pipelines, APIs or web services, relational databases, data warehouses or lakehouses, master data, data quality, and reporting.
* Experience coordinating QA, UAT, change control, deployment readiness, production releases, and transition to operational support.
* Advanced project planning, organization, risk management, dependency management, vendor management, and stakeholder communication skills.
* Ability to translate between business outcomes and technical delivery details and to communicate

technical information clearly to senior management.

* Experience collaborating with distributed teams, offshore development partners, consultants, and third-party vendors.
* Proficiency with Jira and Confluence; experience with complementary planning and reporting tools is valuable.
* Ability to operate effectively in a fast-moving environment with multiple concurrent initiatives and evolving priorities.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Project Manager (Infrastructure, Security & Compliance)
jobs.description:
**Senior Technical Project Manager (Infrastructure, Security & Compliance)**
============================================================================

**Location:** Remote, United States

**Experience:** 5–8 years

**About Tessera Labs**
----------------------

Tessera Labs is redefining how enterprises modernize their most complex systems. Backed by Foundation Capital and built by leaders in AI (Artificial Intelligence) and enterprise transformation, Tessera delivers governed, multi-agent AI built specifically for ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) modernization.

Tessera compresses ERP modernization from years to weeks.

**About the Role**
------------------

The Senior Technical Project Manager is the customer-facing voice of Tessera's infrastructure, security, and compliance organization. You help customers understand how Tessera is built, secured, and governed, and you make sure our internal teams deliver what customers need.

The role has two halves. Internally, you run projects across IT (Information Technology), Security, Compliance, Automation, and Infrastructure. Externally, you join business-side project managers on customer calls, explain our platform in plain language, and turn customer requests into clear, resourced work.

You don't need to be an engineer. You do need enough technical understanding to speak credibly with customer architects and security teams, the curiosity to learn fast, and the judgment to know when to bring in an engineer.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**Customer Engagement**

* Join customer calls with business-side project managers to explain Tessera's infrastructure, deployment models, security controls, and compliance posture.
* Translate technical topics into clear language for customer executives, IT leaders, security reviewers, and procurement teams.
* Guide customers through security reviews, due diligence questionnaires, and compliance evidence requests, from commercial enterprises to government and other regulated customers.
* Identify when a customer needs deeper detail or engineering work, then secure the right internal experts and resources.
* Build trust as a dependable point of contact who follows up and closes loops.

**Internal Cross-Team Project Management**

* Plan and run projects across IT, Security, Compliance, Automation, and Infrastructure teams.
* Turn customer requirements into scoped work with owners, timelines, and dependencies.
* Track risks, blockers, and decisions, and escalate early when timelines or scope are at risk.
* Keep reusable customer-facing materials current, such as architecture overviews, security summaries, and standard questionnaire answers.

**Pipeline and Status Management**

* Own the pipeline of customer infrastructure, security, and compliance requests from intake to close.
* Provide regular status updates to customers, business-side project managers, and Tessera leadership.
* Report on volume, turnaround time, and recurring customer asks to improve how the team works.
* Use AI tools to speed up planning, documentation, and reporting.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 5–8 years of experience in technical project management, technical account management, or customer-facing delivery roles.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with the confidence to lead customer conversations and present to technical and executive audiences.
* Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure (Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform), security concepts, and compliance frameworks such as SOC 2 (System and Organization Controls 2) or ISO/IEC 27001 (International Organization for Standardization / International Electrotechnical Commission 27001). Fluency is required; hands-on engineering is not.
* A proven record of managing cross-functional projects with many stakeholders and competing priorities.
* Strong curiosity and the ability to learn new technical topics quickly and explain them clearly.
* Highly organized, with a habit of written status updates, clear follow-ups, and ownership through completion.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Experience supporting customer security reviews, vendor due diligence, or audits at an enterprise SaaS (Software as a Service) or AI company.
* Exposure to government or regulated-industry customers, including frameworks such as FedRAMP (Federal Risk and Authorization Management Program).
* Familiarity with deployment models such as multi-tenant SaaS, single-tenant, customer cloud, and on-premises.
* A certification such as PMP (Project Management Professional) or CompTIA Security+ (Computing Technology Industry Association Security+).
* Background at a system integrator, enterprise SaaS company, or high-growth startup.

Compensation Range: $160K - $200K

jobs.title: Cyber Security Analyst (SOC)
jobs.description:
At **Epiq** , your work contributes to complex, global legal outcomes. You’ll join a values‑driven community where integrity guides decisions, **relentless service** sets the bar, and we **thrive on big challenges** together. We invest in your growth with enterprise‑wide learning and mobility. We celebrate who you are, and we respect life beyond work with flexibility that’s recognized externally. Enabled by modern platforms and AI, **you’ll do the most meaningful work of your career** and see your impact at scale.

**Job Description:**

Epiq is looking for a **Cyber Security Analyst** **(SOC)** to join our global Security Operations team.

  
  

This is a great opportunity for someone early in their cybersecurity career who wants to do more than simply monitor an alert queue. You’ll gain hands-on experience across **incident response, threat hunting, insider risk, threat intelligence, detection engineering, vulnerability testing, and security automation** while working alongside an experienced, globally distributed security team.

  
  

Our environment is Microsoft-centric, and the team is actively incorporating **automation and AI** into how we investigate threats and improve security operations.

  
  

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Monitor, triage, investigate, and respond to security alerts and incidents.
* Analyze security data to determine severity, impact, and appropriate response or escalation.
* Work with **Microsoft** security tools and other security technologies.
* Conduct threat hunts using emerging threats, indicators of compromise (IOCs), and threat intelligence.
* Investigate insider risk and suspicious user activity.
* Participate in vulnerability testing, purple-team exercises, and detection engineering.
* Help develop and improve detection rules, security playbooks, processes, and automation.
* Collaborate with Security Engineering, Identity & Access Management, and other cybersecurity and IT teams.
* Identify opportunities to use automation and emerging technologies to improve security operations.
  

  

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

We’re looking for someone who is **curious, analytical, and genuinely passionate about cybersecurity** .

  
  

You could be a recent graduate who has built hands-on experience through labs, coursework, certifications, or personal projects. You could also have a year or two of professional cybersecurity experience and be looking for an opportunity to broaden your skills.

Ideally, you’ll bring:

* Foundational knowledge of cybersecurity and incident response.
* Exposure to **SIEM, EDR, antivirus, or other security tools** .
* Strong investigative, troubleshooting, and analytical skills.
* An interest in threat hunting, detection engineering, security automation, or emerging threats.
* A willingness to learn, take ownership, and grow as the security environment evolves.
  

  

**Microsoft security experience is a plus, not a prerequisite.** Experience with platforms such as **Splunk, Elasticsearch, Exabeam, or other SIEM/EDR technologies** can translate well to this environment

  
  

**Education & Experience**
--------------------------

jobs.title: Senior Intelligence Analyst
jobs.description:
**Senior Intelligence Analyst**
===============================

TrapWire helps government agencies and the private sector protect people and critical infrastructure by making better use of their reporting, identifying connections, and understanding emerging threats. We are seeking a Senior Intelligence Analyst to produce clear, well-supported intelligence for our customers and to lead the development of the analytical tradecraft behind it.

This role has two core responsibilities. You will combine TrapWire holdings, including suspicious activity reporting, with independent open source research to produce intelligence that answers customer requirements. You will also lead the development of our analytical standards, sourcing practices, and review process so that every product the team releases meets a consistent, defensible bar.

In a small company supporting consequential missions, your work will directly shape our analytical capability and how customers use it.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* **Customers act on your work.** They receive timely, clearly written intelligence that answers their requirements and explains threat patterns using TrapWire data and independent research.
* **Our products meet a written standard.** You have led the team in publishing an analytic style, sourcing, and confidence guide adapted from ICD 203 and ICD 206.
* **Review is routine and useful.** A review checklist is in use on every disseminated product, and peer review measurably catches sourcing and judgment problems before release.
* **Customers get better at analysis.** Customer analysts receive effective quality-control and matching support and use TrapWire analytical features and workflows more capably.
* **Feedback turns into improvements.** Customer input has led to at least one new or improved product line and specific software recommendations to the Product team.

**What You Will Own**
---------------------

### **Intelligence production**

* **Produce recurring and tailored analytical products.** Help customers understand their data, identify relevant connections and threat patterns, and make informed operational decisions.
* **Analyze suspicious activity reporting.** Examine customer reporting for completeness and consistency, evaluate potential matches and relationships, and distinguish meaningful indicators of pre-operational activity from coincidence or insufficient evidence. Research information gaps and state the limits of apparent connections.
* **Plan and conduct open source collection.** Use automated tools, manual research, and social media research to enrich or challenge assessments based on TrapWire holdings. Evaluate and corroborate sources, maintain traceable sourcing, and operate within applicable legal, privacy, civil rights, and civil liberties protections.

### **Analytical Tradecraft**

* **Develop TrapWire analytical standards.** Write and maintain our style, sourcing, confidence, and collection guidance, adapted from ICD 203 and ICD 206 to TrapWire products and customers.
* **Run a rigorous review process.** Build and maintain review criteria, review colleagues' products, and incorporate their review of yours. Give candid, specific feedback that improves the work.
* **Raise the team's skills.** Share effective methods, develop repeatable workflows, and evaluate new analytical and collection tools.

### **Customer and Product Support**

* **Engage customer analysts and stakeholders.** Understand their intelligence requirements, tailor products, brief findings, and advise on analytical workflows.
* **Train customers on TrapWire analytical features.** Provide practical support and analytical training that makes customers more capable users.
* **Shape the product.** Recommend software improvements to the Product team based on customer feedback and your own assessment of analytical needs.

**The Person We Are Looking For**
---------------------------------

* **Cares about the mission.** You want your analysis to help protect people and give customers a clearer understanding of the threats they face.
* **Follows the evidence.** You evaluate sources critically, challenge assumptions, consider alternative explanations, and revise your judgments when the evidence warrants it.
* **Holds a high bar and helps others reach it.** You care about how intelligence is made, not only what it says, and you can explain a standard well enough that colleagues adopt it.
* **Welcomes rigorous review.** You accept constructive criticism, give candid and respectful feedback, and take shared responsibility for the quality of the team's work.
* **Takes initiative and follows through.** You manage competing priorities, deliver reliably without close supervision, and know when to seek input.
* **Communicates clearly.** You listen to customers, understand the decisions they need to make, and explain complex findings in plain language to analysts, operators, and technical colleagues.
* **Stays curious.** You investigate unfamiliar subjects, learn new tools quickly, and share what works.

**What You Bring**
------------------

* **Five or more years of substantive intelligence-analysis experience** supporting government or private-sector intelligence organizations, with relevant education, formal training, or equivalent demonstrated expertise in structured analytic methods.
* **A record of independently producing finished intelligence.** Clear key judgments, supported arguments, a clear line between reporting and assessment, and precise communication of uncertainty, confidence, and implications.
* **Working command of ICD 203 and ICD 206.** You can apply analytic and sourcing standards and adapt them to a commercial product and non-IC customers.
* **Experience improving other analysts' work.** You have served as a peer reviewer, editor, trainer, or contributor to writing guidance or tradecraft standards, and can point to how your feedback improved products.

jobs.description:
### **About the Role**

The Data Operations Analyst owns lead and account data quality for a hotel-focused sales organization. You'll make sure every prospect that reaches a sales rep is accurate, deduplicated, enriched, and qualified. You'll lead CRM data audits and cleanup, resolve escalations about missing or misrouted leads, and build the qualification processes and SLAs that give the sales team confidence in every lead they're assigned. The role combines technical depth with business judgment.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Make sure leads and accounts entering the pipeline from all source systems are accurate and deduplicated before they reach sales reps.
* Set and keep refining lead qualification standards, and make sure each lead is routed to the right rep, whether the business assigned it or the rep sourced it.
* Own the health of hotel account data in the CRM: clean up duplicate or broken records and keep account structures sound as they interact with other parts of the business.
* Act as the go-to contact when a rep hits a data problem, such as a missing lead, a bad match, or a data error. Fix the underlying process, not just the single ticket.
* Identify where AI genuinely speeds up data QA, enrichment, or anomaly detection, and hold any AI you deploy to measurable standards, such as false-positive rates.
* Build and document scalable data workflows.

### **Qualifications**

**Required**

* 5-6+ years of experience in data operations or go-to-market (GTM) engineering.
* Hands-on experience with Salesforce or a comparable CRM, including account structuring, deduplication, field mapping, and data cleanup.
* Strong data-quality instincts: you can navigate complex, imperfect data structures, find and fix inconsistencies, and connect business use cases back to data pipelines.
* Experience designing or refining lead qualification criteria and SLAs.
* Demonstrated experience sourcing or evaluating third-party data vendors and enrichment tools.
* Strong SQL skills for validating data, investigating anomalies, and pulling ad hoc analysis.
* Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills.
* Experience using AI tools (for example, Claude Code) to build lightweight internal processes.
* Clear, proactive communication, with comfort partnering directly with sales reps and sales leadership on escalations.
* A process-oriented mindset.

**Preferred**

* Experience in a B2B or marketplace environment.
* Python skills.

### **Key Details**

* Start date: November 17, 2026
* Duration: Approximately 12 months (through November 12, 2027)
* Location: Remote (within the U.S.)
* Work schedule: 40 hours per week, 8 hours per day, 5 days per week

Mass General Brigham relies on a wide range of professionals, including doctors, nurses, business people, tech experts, researchers, and systems analysts to advance our mission. As a not-for-profit, we support patient care, research, teaching, and community service, striving to provide exceptional care. We believe that high-performing teams drive groundbreaking medical discoveries and invite all applicants to join us and experience what it means to be part of Mass General Brigham.

**Job Summary**

Across the healthcare industry nationwide, hospitals and health systems face challenges to today’s approaches to expense management, as revenue growth has not kept pace with expense growth. In response to these unprecedented external challenges, MGB launched Sustain in fall of 2023. Sustain is an ongoing organization-wide program that works to build an infrastructure, culture, and mindset around continuous improvement, working to preserve our four-part mission through focus on resource stewardship. To do this, while also funding needed capital maintenance and improvements to deliver on world-class patient care, research, education, and community health, we must seek out innovative opportunities to optimize the way we work and manage resources across our organization.  
  
The Sustain Analytics team is part of the Business Planning department, which also includes Decision Support and Business Analytics teams. The Business Analyst (Finance), on the Sustain Analytics team is responsible for supporting a broad range of analytic, planning, benchmarking, and other operational support activities for one or more designated members of the Leadership Team (Senior VP’s, Clinical VP’s, Operating VP’s and Executive Directors), across the enterprise, under the guidance of senior team members.
  
  
A critical measure of each Business Analyst’s success will be the extent to which the analytic and planning needs of each person supported are met in a timely, consistent, high quality manner. This will require close collaboration with staff within the clinical departments, and many other analytic, financial, and planning groups throughout the MGB enterprise, including Sustain Management Office (SMO), Business Planning, Financial Planning, Digital, and local financial, operational, and analytical teams and decision-making bodies at each of the MGB entities. An ability to synthesize, summarize and effectively communicate the analytic and planning work that is performed is key.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree required; Academic experience focused in finance, financial analytics, data analytics, and/or operations management
* 2+ years of healthcare, financial, or business analysis experience required
* Experience in materials management analytics, clinical supply utilization analytics, surgical capacity, and/or data analytics preferred; relevant internship or co-op experience will be considered
* Experience working in a health system, hospital and/or similar medical center environment preferred.

**Principal Duties and Responsibilities:**

**Surgical Profitability: General**

* Support data analytic needs that inform strategic business decision making on surgical profitability, including surgical cost reduction, clinical supply utilization optimization, OR efficiency, and improved block scheduling, offering direct support for select service lines including Orthopedics and/or Heart and Vascular.
* + Assessing current state surgical profitability for comparable procedures performed in perioperative and procedural areas across the MGB enterprise
* + Identifying potential areas of opportunity through analyzing differences in clinical supply utilization across and within the different entities at MGB, including surgeon and product variation and waste reduction
* + Collaborating with perioperative and procedural teams areas to better understand clinical application and financial opportunity, relative to quality and preference
* + Quantifying financial impact of any recommended changes in practice
* + Assist with financial reporting and analysis by procedure and/or procedure groups to enhance service line growth strategy across the perioperative and procedural areas
* + Utilize industry benchmarks to compare cost, profitability, utilization, and pricing for procedural cases and clinical supplies
* Support the development of consistent executive level reporting, to be used by clinical and administrative leaders within the perioperative and procedural areas, to measure performance and support best practice across the enterprise
* Help catalogue current state analytics across various systems, and support the development of standard analytics and reporting in one single system to meet varied stakeholder needs across the enterprise
* Escalate challenges, discrepancies, roadblocks regarding data and analytics to manager or appropriate data owner

**Surgical Profitability: Information Systems Management**

* Support external system used for surgical capacity and surgical cost/clinical supply utilization reporting:
* + Support administrative maintenance of system through collaborating with appropriate internal and external teams, escalating data or system issues to leadership, and communicating downtime and system updates to end users
* Assist in creating deliverables for executive and c-suite level leadership, summarizing performance and related comments from local entities and departments
* + Support ad hoc inquiries and analytics from department leaders
* Support leadership across Business Planning, Digital, and Perioperative Leadership with routine system maintenance and upgrades

**Communication Activities**

* Prepare concise, clear, professional summaries of analyses and plans for review by senior team members and Senior Leadership, as appropriate.
* Present findings to staff and stakeholders, targeting the presentation towards the knowledge level and needs of the audience

jobs.title: AMC KC-46 MFOQA Flight Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Universal Technical Resource Services, Inc. (UTRS) is currently seeking an AMC KC-46 MFOQA Analyst to join our team! At UTRS, we enjoy the benefits of working in a collaborative environment of close-knit team members. As a company, we provide a wide range of leading-edge engineering, management, and digital services to the public and private sectors. We are looking for someone that will support our mission to consistently deliver creative, high-quality, technology-based services to our customers on time and within budget.

  

This position, KC-46 Military Flight Operations Quality Assurance (MFOQA) Flight Data Analyst (FDA), works with the Air Mobility Command (AMC) MFOQA Program Manager to measure and manage operational safety hazards and trends across the KC-46 fleet for MFOQA program enhancement and support. Additionally, the FDA enhances flight safety through the management and analysis of data collected from MFOQA utilizing the Safety Integrated Risk Information System (S-IRIS) and state-of-the-art commercial data visualization software programs. This position is remote.

**What will you be doing?**

  

This position will be a key member of the UTRS Aviation Safety Technology team. Duties include:

* Utilize software to analyze recorded aircraft information/flight data in relation to Triggered Events (TEs) and Routine Operational Measurements (ROMs); verify and validate aircraft specific measurement sets; generate flight operations trends and special studies; and detect hazardous conditions and risks.
* Assist AMC MFOQA Program Manager to support AMC's Aviation Safety Action program (ASAP).
* Advocate MFOQA/ASAP program goals, benefits, and proper uses within AMC, and the AF, including AFSEC's Proactive Aviation Safety.
* Assist analysis team in developing, deploying, and sustaining processes that facilitate the collection, reporting, analysis, quality control, and visualization of MFOQA and ASAP data and transformation into actionable information for identifying, assessing, mitigating, and tracking operational hazards.
* Provide knowledge of Tanker/Airlift operational environments, the missions flown, and the maneuvers performed during those missions.
* Interface regularly with analysis team, AMC staff, AFSEC staff, and units to identify areas of interest; generate analysis products; present emerging trends, hazards, and risks; and disseminate (within and outside AMC/MAF) analysis results and corrective actions.
* Collaborate with the AMC MFOQA Program Manager to identify trends and deviations from standard procedures and parameters; identify corrective actions; coordinate implementation of corrective actions with AMC staff; and evaluate effectiveness of any corrective actions undertaken.
* Assist in the development, evaluation, monitoring, and compliance with MFOQA/ASAP regulations, policies, standards, and procedures.
* Generate informational articles, briefings, case studies, cost benefit analysis, marketing materials, and training materials to stakeholders and designated users throughout the MAF and targeted bases on MFOQA and ASAP safety findings, corrective actions, program plans, goals, objectives, benefits, schedule, and the road ahead.
* Assist AMC MFOQA Program Manager with the development of long-term funding needs and POM submittals.
* Support MFOQA/ASAP-related meetings, including MFOQA Program Management Reviews, meetings with Sister Services, Aircraft Information Working Groups, System Safety Groups, industry safety forums, and presentations to Air Staff, AMC, AFSEC, and program office personnel.
* Participate in working groups and design reviews to ensure that MFOQA requirements are included in any proposed upgrades to flight recorders and other data acquisition systems.

  

**What skills will the ideal candidate have to be successful?**

This position will require the following skillsets and experience:

  

* Bachelor’s degree or higher
* 10 years of flight experience as a tanker or airlift pilot

* Joint, HAF, MAJCOM, or NAF staff experience a plus
* Formal USAF Safety Training a plus
* General knowledge of the Guard and Reserve component of AMC

* Technical requirements
  + Military aviation experience and extensive knowledge of tanker aircraft operational environments, operating characteristics, standards, missions flown, and the maneuvers performed for military tanker aircraft.
  + Knowledge of and experience with aviation safety programs, including MFOQA, ASAP, and LOSA, and operational risk management and processes.
  + Proven ability to collaborate with all echelons, from headquarters staff to squadron operations and maintenance.
* Analytical and database software proficiency desired (Excel, Tableau, etc.)
* S. Citizenship required? Yes
* Security Clearance? Yes (Secret)
* Travel required? Yes (Anticipate travel approximately 1 trip every 3-6 months.)

  

Read about our benefits here: Our Benefits - UTRS | Always, Got Your Back

UTRS is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. jobs.description:
**Company Description**

At Northwestern Medicine, every patient interaction makes a difference in cultivating a positive workplace. This patient-first approach is what sets us apart as a leader in the healthcare industry. As an integral part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to join our quest for better health care, no matter where you work within the Northwestern Medicine system. We pride ourselves on providing competitive benefits: from tuition reimbursement and loan forgiveness to 401(k) matching and lifecycle benefits, our goal is to take care of our employees. Ready to join our quest for better?

 **Job Description**

The **HB Coding Strategic Data Analyst** role exists to transform complex coding into actionable insights that drive performance, compliance, and strategic decision-making across Northwestern Medicine's Hospital Billing Coding operations. The position serves as a critical link between data, technology, and operational leadership by providing meaningful analysis and reporting that supports efficient workflows, revenue cycle performance, coding quality, productivity, and organizational goals.

Through the development and management of reports, dashboards, performance metrics, and analytics, this role enables coding leadership to identify outpatient trends, measure outcomes, evaluate operational effectiveness, and make informed decisions that improve financial performance, and coding accuracy. The HB Coding Strategic Data Analyst supports Coding leadership, ensuring leaders have the data and insights needed to manage resources, prioritize initiatives, and plan for future organizational needs.

Additionally, the position fosters collaboration among key stakeholders to support reporting, workflow optimization, technology enhancements, and process improvement initiatives. By leveraging data analytics, Epic, and other reporting tools, the HB Coding Strategic Data Analyst helps advance operational excellence, support organizational growth, and contribute to Northwestern Medicine's commitment to high-quality patient care and financial stewardship.

**This position is 100% remote**

**Responsibilities:**

* Serves as the primary analytics resource for Coding Leadership transforming coding, revenue cycle, operational, and financial data into actionable insights that support strategic and operational decision-making.
* Develop, maintain, and enhance dashboards, scorecards, key performance indicators (KPIs), routine reports, and ad hoc analyses related to productivity, quality, accounts receivable, budgets, vendor performance, and workflow outcomes on a daily, weekly, monthly, and fiscal-year cadence.
* Analyze coding and revenue cycle data to identify trends, risks, variances, and improvement opportunities, and provide actionable recommendations to leadership and operational teams.
* Translate complex analytical findings into clear reports, presentations, and visualizations that communicate performance results, risks, opportunities, and recommendations to stakeholders.
* Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to resolve issues, support reporting needs, and achieve organizational objectives.
* Utilize Epic, computer-assisted coding (CAC) technology, Power BI, Microsoft applications, and reporting tools to evaluate system functionality, validate business requirements, coordinates user acceptance testing, post-implementation validation, and optimize operational performance.
* Coordinate coding technology activities by documenting workflows, supporting upgrades and troubleshooting efforts, managing IS ticket documentation and status reporting, and serving as a subject matter expert for Epic and CAC workflows.
* Lead and support reporting, technology, and continuous improvement initiatives by applying project management principles, strengthening data integrity, documenting requirements and decisions, and streamlining departmental workflows.

**Additional Functions**

* Other duties as assigned

  
**Qualifications**

**Minimum Requirements:**

* **Education:** Associate’s degree in health information management, Health Informatics, or a related field; or equivalent education and relevant experience.
* **Experience:**
  + 3 years of data analytics
  + Working knowledge of Key Performance Indicators management
  + Microsoft Office, including advanced Excel functions
  + Epic and computer-assisted coding technology
* **Licensure:** None required.
* **Certification:**
  + **HIM Membership:** AHIMA or AAPC
  + **Epic certification:** Applicable Epic reporting certification required at hire or within six months
* **Behavioral Attributes:** Demonstrates attention to detail and consistently monitors work for accuracy. Use critical thinking to draw conclusions and make recommendations. Communicates clearly in writing and verbally, collaborates effectively across teams, manages competing priorities, and maintains accountability for assigned work.

**Preferred:**

* Acute care revenue cycle experience
* Project management experience
* Healthcare coding analytics
* EPIC Cogito, Reporting Workbench, Slicer Dicer, or applicable Epic reporting
* Dashboard development and data visualization
* Budget, productivity, and quality analysis
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in health information management, Health Informatics, or a related field; or equivalent education and relevant experience.
* Coding credential: RHIA

Addendum 2 – Inpatient HB Coding Strategic Data Analyst

* Demonstrate expertise in inpatient coding principles and regulatory requirements, including ICD-10-CM, Procedure Coding System (PCS) coding, and official coding guidelines.
* Demonstrate expertise in denials including DRG downgrades and writing appeal letters.
* Coding/HIM credential: RHIT or CCS
* Experience
  + 3 years of inpatient coding experience
  + Reviewing and writing appeal letters for payer denials and DRG downgrades

**About Niyam IT (Niyam)**

Niyam was founded in 2007 by a group of consultants who shared a unique vision: a technology company steeped in orderly process yet driven by passion and innovation. For nearly two decades, we have served the U.S. Federal government delivering mission-critical IT solutions across Emergency Preparedness and Response, Civilian Agency Services, and Law Enforcement and Public Safety.

Niyam is CMMI DEV Level 3 accredited and ISO certified (ISO 9001:2015, ISO/IEC 20000-1, ISO/IEC 27001), and holds an active CMMC Level 2 certification. We are proud to be recognized as a Best Places to Work by The Washington Post (2025) and USA Today (2026).

**What We Offer:**

* **Flexible Work Hours**: Life doesn’t always fit into a 9-to-5 schedule. We offer flexibility to help you manage your work-life balance effectively.
* **Remote Work**: Niyam understands the value of flexibility. We offer remote work.
* **Career Growth**: Niyam is not just a job; it’s a career journey. We provide a supportive environment for your professional development and offer fully paid opportunities for training and advancement within the company.
* **Great People**: Our people are the blueprint of who Niyam is to the industry and community.
* **Great Environment**: Niyam fosters a great environment where innovation, collaboration, and personal growth thrive.
* **Diversity & Inclusion**: We believe in the strength of diverse perspectives. Your unique ideas are welcomed and celebrated every day at Niyam.

  

Join us in creating a workplace where innovation, diversity, and well-being thrive. Your journey at Niyam awaits. Apply today!

  

Niyam is seeking an experienced **Maximo Business Analyst** to join our team in support of our work with a federal client. This position will lead the design, implementation, and optimization of enterprise asset management solutions in a complex environment. In this role, you will work closely with business stakeholders, developers, and operations teams to configure, customize, and enhance system functionality. You will support system integrations, troubleshoot issues, and drive performance improvements while ensuring alignment with organizational standards and best practices. The expert will also play a key role in gathering requirements, guiding solution architecture, supporting upgrades and deployments, and identifying opportunities for process automation and continuous improvement to maximize the value of the Maximo platform.

  

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

* Lead requirements gathering activities through stakeholder interviews, design workshops, discovery sessions, and business process reviews to define use cases and document business needs.
* Translate business and operational requirements into detailed Business Requirements Documents (BRDs), functional specifications, user stories, workflow diagrams, process maps, and related project documentation.
* Facilitate effective communication and coordination between business units, technical resources, and project teams throughout the project lifecycle.
* Analyze the Maximo database structure and evaluate the impact of proposed changes to objects, tables, indexes, relationships, and configurations.
* Collaborate with developers, architects, system administrators, and integration teams to design, configure, implement, and support Maximo solutions.
* Assess current-state business processes and recommend process improvements, automation opportunities, and create proof-of-concept solutions with industry’s best practices.
* Lead discussions related to system integrations, reporting requirements, data conversion strategies, and data migration planning and execution activities.
* Develop, maintain, and manage technical and functional documentation, including system configuration documents, standard operating procedures (SOPs), training materials, and knowledge base articles.

  

**Requirements**:

* US Citizen with ability to successfully complete federal background investigation.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* 5+ years of hands-on experience in Maximo configuration and customization.
* Relevant certifications such as IBM Certified Maximo Application Developer or related credentials.
* Experience working on projects requiring regulatory compliance in asset management systems.
* Demonstrated expertise in the configuration of IBM Maximo Application Suite, including business objects, attributes, domains, workflows, escalations, and application configurations.
* Strong ability to evaluate business operations and identify opportunities to enhance efficiency, reliability, compliance, and user experience through process optimization and effective utilization of system capabilities.
* In-depth understanding of Maximo database architecture, relational data models, indexing strategies, and the operational impact of configuration and structural changes within the environment.
* Proven analytical and problem-solving capabilities, including experience troubleshooting system issues and optimizing application and database performance.
* Ability to facilitate collaboration between business stakeholders, technical teams, and project leadership to ensure alignment with project objectives, operational priorities, and organizational goals.

jobs.description:
User ops
  
  
Sports Program Manager - TikTok Content Operation - New York
  
  
**Location :**  
New York
  
  
**Employment Type :**  
Regular
  
  
**Job Code :**  
A59793
  
  
Responsibilities
  
  
TikTok's Sports operations team is responsible for delivering high-quality, efficient and effective B2B experiences for our major partners and internal stakeholders. Primarily, this is delivered through program management, operational infrastructure, and scalable processes that support global media businesses. The Sports Program Manager will manage high-priority programs that support TikTok’s Sports publisher ecosystem, including content partnership programs, tentpole moments, audience growth initiatives, product go-to-market efforts, and operational frameworks for Sports partners. This role will work closely with cross-functional teams across Product, Partnerships, Creator Management, Business Development, Global Monetization & Product team and more. The ideal candidate has strong program management experience, a deep interest in the Sports industry, and the ability to translate complex partner, product, and market needs into clear operating plans and strategies. Responsibilities: - Deliver end-to-end program management for Sports content partnerships, publisher programs, global collaborations, tentpole moments, and audience growth initiatives. - Lead cross-functional alignment with key teams including Product, Partnerships, Creator Management, Business Development, Global Monetization & Product team and more. - Deliver owned and operated product go-to-market and partner accelerator programs for Sports publishers and creators, including clear rollout plans, partner education, feedback loops, and market expansion strategies. - Build operational infrastructure to streamline and scale Sports programs, including processes for partner onboarding, campaign execution, reporting, documentation, and internal visibility. - Create communication channels, frameworks, templates, best practice playbooks, and resources to support Sports program execution across markets. - Partner with internal teams to identify publisher needs, surface product and operational feedback, and help shape scalable solutions that support high-quality Sports content. - Develop foundational operational products and processes that empower teams to execute and evolve Sports programs and at scale. - Assist in design and launch of new operational processes, and deliver end-to-end project management for operational processes. - Support management of internal and external stakeholders to set and exceed performance goals.
  
  
Qualifications
  
  
**Minimum Qualification(s):** - 5+ years of experience in programme management and leadership experience. - Experience working with or strong grasp of Sports, digital media, publishers, or content ecosystems. - Have a deep understanding and insights of the key metrics and measurements in content, publisher, or creator operations, including audience growth, engagement, retention, partner performance, and operational efficiency. - Natural collaborator with the ability to drive alignment among diverse stakeholders across Marketing, GBS, Product, Data, Algorithm, User Growth, and more. - Strong understanding of local business dynamics, market nuances, and the evolving digital Sports landscape, with intellectual curiosity to dive deeply into complex issues. - Experience working in a global or highly cross-functional role, including building relationships across regions, markets, and stakeholder groups. - Strong ability to manage ambiguity, prioritize competing workstreams, and translate strategic goals into actionable operating plans. jobs.title: Fraud Intelligence Analyst (New Graduate)
jobs.description:
**About Us**
------------

Dashly is a fraud intelligence startup that uses data across employers, insurers, and contractors to fight fraud in injury claims. We expose fraud networks that cost Americans billions of dollars annually, slow commercial development, and erode trust in blue-collar industries.

Backed by Mosaic GP, Altai Ventures, and Remarkable Ventures, with a $5.8M seed round.

**About the Role**
------------------

Fraud is rarely one person acting alone. Organized claim fraud is often run by networks: groups of associated people acting together through a pattern of related claims over time. The cost falls on carriers, contractors, and the industries that depend on fair claims. The evidence is public but fragmented across dockets, deposition transcripts, claim files, and social media.

Dashly investigates organized fraud enterprises: formal or informal groups of individuals, and the counsel, providers, and associates around them, linked by shared addresses, phone numbers, employers, and narratives. We build cases around the structure of organized fraud: the enterprise, each member's association with it, a pattern of related conduct, how long that conduct continues, and its reach across state lines. Our work gives clients and their counsel evidence for fraud litigation.

As a Fraud Intelligence Analyst, you will design, run, and QA the automated OSINT workflows behind our investigations. You will build and orchestrate agentic AI workflows (LLM agents) for account discovery and attribution, court-filing and deposition extraction, media review, and report drafting. You will integrate third-party OSINT, licensed, and public-records data sources via API, and you will own detection quality (precision, recall, and false-positive rate) across the pipeline.

This role suits a recent graduate in cybercrime, cybersecurity, criminal justice, intelligence, computer science, or a related field who combines a builder's mindset with an investigator's rigor. Prior military or government experience is welcome.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Design and operationalize automated OSINT workflows that take a claim from initial identifiers to a finished report: account discovery, attribution, collection, court-document extraction, and link analysis.
* Build, prompt, and supervise AI agents and LLM-based automation for investigative tasks, with human-in-the-loop verification before any output reaches a client.
* Integrate OSINT, licensed, and public-records data sources through their APIs, and evaluate each new data source on historical cases before production use.
* Measure and improve detection quality: track precision, recall, and false-positive and false-negative rates against analyst-confirmed accounts, and tune workflows accordingly.
* Identify, attribute, and verify claimants' online accounts and records using strong identifiers (address, phone, email, date of birth).
* Review public photos and posts and flag activity that contradicts claimant testimony or statements to the insurer.
* Extract facts from court filings, deposition transcripts, and claim files, and use link analysis to map relationships among claimants, counsel, addresses, phone numbers, and associates, documenting enterprise structure, member associations, and patterns of related conduct across claims.
* Produce clear, evidence-backed investigative reports that clients and their counsel can use in fraud litigation.
* Partner with senior investigators and engineers to refine investigative methods, tooling, and report quality.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* **Required:** Experience using AI coding agents, terminal coding agents, or CLI-based AI development tools for research, writing, or code, with the judgment to validate their output (Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, or open source tools).
* Bachelor's or master's degree (or in progress) in cybercrime, cybersecurity, criminal justice, intelligence, computer science, or a related field.
* 0-2 years of experience in OSINT, investigations, threat intelligence, or a related discipline, including coursework, internships, CTF competitions, or military or government service.
* Working knowledge of OSINT collection and analysis techniques and rigorous source documentation.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience integrating REST APIs and working with structured data (JSON), SQL for querying and analyzing large datasets.
* Familiarity with graph and network analysis for detecting linked actor structures.
* Understanding of detection-performance concepts (precision, recall, false positives).
* Familiarity with court records and legal documents, including dockets, deposition transcripts, and fraud complaints.
* Proficiency in Python or a similar scripting language for data analysis and task automation.

**Compensation & Benefits**
---------------------------

* **Compensation:** The base salary range is $61,000 – $100,000, with flexibility depending on a candidate's background and experience. A company equity plan is also included in our compensation package.
* **Well-being:** 100% medical coverage with dental and vision.
* **Sponsorship:** We welcome candidates on OPT (Optional Practical Training). We do not offer other visa sponsorship.
* **Location:** This role is based on-site 5 days per week in our Chelsea, NY office.
* **Work Expectations:** This role requires a minimum of 50 hours per week.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. The global privacy regulatory landscape is not static, and the product and technical landscape at Meta changes multiple times daily to continue to meet and meet the needs of our more than 3.5 billion daily users on our platform. The Compliance Assurance Program Manager (CAPM) works at the center of privacy regulation, legal, business, product, and engineering to put our users' privacy at the center of everything we do.The Exam & Audit (E&A) team, part of Meta's Regulatory Compliance Program (RCP), manages Meta's regulatory examination and audit engagements. E&A connects internal stakeholders with external assessors and regulators. Its work includes delivering external assessor testing on time and at quality, defending the program's position on findings, and driving remediation of identified gaps. As the second line of defense, E&A also gives compliance advice and independent oversight of Meta's privacy safeguards. It challenges their design and effectiveness so that compliance becomes a catalyst for trusted, responsible product growth rather than a constraint.This role sits in the Third Party Risk Management (TPRM) domain. The CAPM will be the second-line partner for these safeguards and will lead their readiness for independent assessment.We are looking for an individual contributor who brings audit, risk, and privacy expertise to serve as a trusted second-line advisor and assessment lead for third-party safeguards. jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst - Disney DTC Sports & ESPN Analytics
jobs.description:
**Job Requirements**  

**SUMMARY**
===========

The Disney DTC Sports & ESPN Analytics team is seeking a Senior Data Analyst who will be an exceptional addition to our team. You will be responsible for turning data into information, information into insights, and insights into key business decisions that steer the strategic direction of ESPN's direct-to-consumer product strategy. The right person for this role has exceptional analytical capabilities, thrives in a fast-paced environment, loves problem-solving, is a good communicator, and is passionate about high quality digital product experiences.

You will play a key role in building out ESPN's product analytics function from the ground up, serving as a dedicated point of contact and thought partner for the ESPN product and product engineering teams. You will lead the foundational work streams for ESPN app measurement: standing up a governed, centralized source of truth for ESPN app performance metrics — canonical definitions, consistent logic, and numbers the business can align on — and building the self-serve tooling that lets stakeholders not only see that a KPI moved, but locate what drove the movement. You will also be the experimentation partner to the product organization, shaping how ESPN app features are tested and how those results are read.

This role is hands-on and technical. You will design and maintain the aggregation logic and metric tables that sit underneath executive reporting, and you will be expected to defend the numbers you publish — including the measurement caveats that travel with them.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Own and evolve the source-of-truth metric layer for ESPN app performance — headline KPIs (DAU, time spent, watch minutes), their definitions, their dimensional breakouts, and the documented caveats that accompany each
* Design and maintain pre-aggregated metric tables and serving views in Snowflake, and the scheduled pipelines that refresh them, ensuring metrics are correct at every level of aggregation
* Build the monitoring and decomposition logic that identifies when a KPI movement is real and where it is concentrated — baselines, significance thresholds, contribution ranking, and volume-versus-mix splits
* Distinguish genuine behavioral movements from measurement artifacts and instrumentation breakage, and partner with product engineering to close the analytics QA gap on client releases
* Build dashboards and self-serve tooling in Looker that reduce stakeholder reliance on ad-hoc analyst pulls
* Conduct analyses using SQL and Python to access and manipulate multivariate product and behavioral data, and ideate new metrics and analytical approaches for in-app user behavior
* Partner with product and engineering on experimentation end-to-end — translating a product question into a testable hypothesis, selecting primary and guardrail metrics, sizing and powering the test, validating assignment and exposure, analyzing the readout, and diagnosing what happened when a test misbehaves or reads flat
* Reconcile ESPN app metrics across teams and systems, and drive alignment on definitions with Research, Data Product, and data engineering partners
* Serve as a dedicated point of contact and thought partner for ESPN product and product engineering teams, taking projects end-to-end from vague business need to socialized insight
* Communicate results through compelling data storytelling to product leadership and the broader ESPN business

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**

* Degree in an analytical area such as Mathematics, Statistics, Operations Research, Computer Science, Economics, or equivalent practical experience
* 5+ years of relevant work experience in analytics, product analytics, and/or business intelligence
* Advanced SQL — able to read and write complex analytical queries, and to reason about correctness of aggregation logic (for example, why a distinct-count metric cannot be summed across segments)
* Working proficiency in Python for data manipulation, analysis, and pipeline work
* Practical understanding of data warehousing and dimensional modeling — how metric tables are structured, refreshed, and served to downstream consumers
* Applied statistical judgment: constructing baselines, assessing whether a change is meaningful versus noise, and handling seasonality and day-of-week effects
* Hands-on product experimentation experience — designing and executing A/B and multivariate tests, analyzing results (significance, confidence intervals, minimum detectable effect, guardrail metrics), and diagnosing common failure modes such as sample ratio mismatch, assignment or exposure leakage, interaction effects, and novelty decay
* Experience with data visualization tools (Looker, Tableau, or equivalent) coupled with strong storytelling skills for technical and non-technical audiences
* Experience taking vague requirements and manipulating them into polished final products
* Strong and effective communication and presentation skills

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Hands-on experience with digital clickstream or behavioral analytics data (Adobe Analytics, Amplitude, or similar), including its identity and measurement limitations
* Experience with Databricks, PySpark, or comparable large-scale data processing
* Experience establishing metric governance — canonical definitions, reconciliation across teams, and change management on metric logic
* Experience with an experimentation platform (Optimizely, Statsig, Amplitude Experiment, or in-house) and with scaling experimentation practice across product teams
* Familiarity with identity resolution across web, app, and connected TV, and the practical consequences of cookie-based measurement
* Prior experience in Sports or Media/Entertainment
