jobs.description:
Job ID: 2618747

**Location:** Pearl City, HI, US

**Date Posted:** 2026-11-04

**Category:** Program Management

**Subcategory:** Project Analyst

**Schedule:** Full-Time

**Shift:** Day Job

**Travel:** Yes - 25% of the time

**Minimum Clearance Required:** Secret

**Clearance Level Must Be Able to Obtain:** TS/SCI

**Potential for Remote Work:** ORA\_ON\_SITE

**Description**

SAIC is seeking a **Technical Deputy Project Manager** located in **Pearl City, HI** to support the Regional Synthetic Training Environment (RSTE) under the Regional Joint Training Infrastructure (RJTI) Integrated Project Team (IPT) for **USPACOM at the Pacific Warfighting Center (PWC).** This position is the RSTE Project Manager, supporting the RSTE IPT Lead by leading planning, coordination, and execution of RSTE delivery across Product Teams.

**JOB DESCRIPTION:**

* Support the Regional Synthetic Training Environment (RSTE) Integrated Project Team (IPT) Lead in day-to-day direction of RSTE execution across cross-functional Product Teams (Platform, Core Services, Compliance & Authorization, Enterprise Architecture, Core Engineering/ERB, Mission Applications, and Data Foundation), including coordination of tasking, prioritization, and performance feedback input for a matrixed team of 10+ personnel.
* Provide day-to-day project coordination, mentorship support, and team facilitation aligned with SAIC values and customer mission needs.
* Establish and help enforce project governance processes (decision authorities, issue escalation paths, change-control intake) consistent with the RJTI IPT Charter, ensuring disciplined execution and clear accountability.
* Assist the IPT Lead in planning, coordinating, and executing RSTE capabilities that enable multi-domain training, mission rehearsal, and experimentation in support of USPACOM objectives.
* Develop and manage project schedules, resource tracking, and integrated planning artifacts under IPT Lead direction, including GitLab project plan content and milestone tracking for MVP/Threshold, IOC, and FOC deliveries.
* Decompose RSTE scope into manageable work packages aligned to Product Team backlogs and Design Review outcomes.
* Organize and coordinate project work with a diverse team of government, contractor, and partner personnel.
* Coordinate with multiple stakeholders—including military and civilian personnel, Product Teams, and mission partners—to ensure synchronized program execution.
* Monitor project progress, identify risks and dependencies, and implement or recommend mitigation strategies; maintain visibility in the risk register for IPT Lead and ESG review.
* Prepare and present regular status reports and briefings to the IPT Lead, senior leadership, and stakeholders.
* Support IPT battle rhythm: meeting logistics, agendas, action-item tracking, decision logs, and archival of minutes and guidance under IPT Lead approval.
* Assist with change-control packaging so yellow/red items (scope, cost, ATO boundary, architecture) are ready for IPT Lead or Government/ESG adjudication per the IPT Charter.
* Coordinate with Compliance & Authorization and cybersecurity stakeholders to keep RMF/ATO-C status, residual risk, and related dependencies visible to leadership.
* Ensure compliance with applicable regulations, policies, and procedures.
* Maintain a flexible demeanor and willingness to support other duties as needed.

**Qualifications**

**REQUIRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Bachelors and ten (10)+ years or more of relevant experience; additional four (4) years of experience accepted in lieu of degree.
* Proven experience as a Project Manager, preferably within a military or defense environment.
* Experience translating complex operational and technical requirements into clear project plans, priorities, and actionable guidance for the team.
* Demonstrated experience leading or coordinating cross-functional teams and managing subcontractors or partner organizations, including performance management, conflict resolution, and stakeholder engagement.
* Demonstrated capability to mentor and develop junior team members, fostering a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and mission focus.
* Familiarity with Agile or Product Team constructs and modern project management tools and methodologies.
* Ability to work independently and within a diverse team.
* Familiarity with USINDOPACOM's mission and operations preferred.
* Must be able to obtain a Passport and be willing to travel up to 25%.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Cloud computing experience (Azure Government, Microsoft 365 Government, hybrid cloud, or equivalent DoD cloud environments).
* RMF experience (NIST SP 800-53, ATO/ATO-C packages, continuous monitoring, or collaboration with ISSM/ISSE/3PAO).
* Exposure to Zero Trust, identity/ICAM, or mission partner environment (MPE) concepts.
* Experience supporting Design Reviews, steering groups, or Agile release planning in a DoD IPT.
* Understanding of multi-domain training, LVC, or synthetic training infrastructure.
* Prior work with USPACOM J7/J76, Pacific Warfighting Center, or theater training organizations.

**REQUIRED CLEARANCE:**

* Must have an Active Secret security clearance with the ability to obtain a Top Secret/SCI clearance.
* Must be a current U.S. Citizen.

Target salary range: $120,001 - $160,000. The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience and other factors.

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

At AWS, Security is priority zero. As part of the Amazon Web Services (AWS) Security team, we are looking for a Technical Program Manager who is passionate about how AWS identifies, evaluates, and resolves security compliance risk, and wants to help build the systems that make it possible. The Risk and Compliance Remediation (RCR) team is moving from a reactive remediation function to a proactive, intelligence driven remediation engine that eliminates systemic security compliance risk at its root, before findings reach auditors, customers, or regulators.  
You will remediate technical security compliance issues across AWS service teams, working with builder teams to understand the technical gap, evaluate solutions, and negotiate an agreed remediation plan and timeline that closes the issue. You will also own the delivery of cross team technical remediation programs, and you will partner with engineering teams on engagements to improve AWS’s remediation tracking system, the source of truth for every issue. You will gather requirements, drive technical tradeoffs, and deliver improvements to that system and the automation built on it, translating compliance requirements and risk advisory guidance into actionable technical work. You bring a solid understanding of the design approaches and technologies in your program area, spot risks, and ask the right technical questions to make sure the right tradeoffs are made for the customer and for the engineers who build and maintain these systems.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
In this role, you will:  

* Own a program of technical remediations, scoping, planning, and driving delivery across multiple AWS service teams, partnering with engineering teams to secure resources, set milestones, and meet deadlines
* Work technical remediation issues end to end, partnering with security engineers and builder teams to understand the technical gap, evaluate solution options (automation, configuration changes, compensating controls, architectural changes), and negotiate an agreed remediation solution and timeline that closes the compliance issue
* Negotiate remediation priority with engineering leads alongside their roadmap commitments, using data on risk, audit deadlines, and builder cost to reach decisions that hold up with both service teams and auditors
* Own technical remediation campaigns across dozens of AWS service teams from evaluation through close, determining whether the work can be done centrally or automated before launching a campaign, and building the case with data, effort estimates, and clear return on investment
* Serve as theme owner for technically complex root cause themes within RCR's thematic remediation approach, negotiating remediation prioritization with engineering leads and tracking measurable reduction in recurring findings
* Drive away team TPM engagements with engineering teams to enhance the remediation tracking system, owning requirements gathering, writing functional requirements and technical specifications, and representing RCR as the customer in design reviews
* Understand the remediation tracking system's architecture, its upstream and downstream integrations, and data model well enough to spot risks, ask the right technical questions, and make sure dependencies are not broken by changes
* Make and document tradeoffs across time, scope, and cost for both remediation programs and tracking system feature delivery, escalating appropriately when designs are too complex or risky
* Provide operational and execution context for risk acceptance decisions, assessing whether remediation is feasible within a given timeline, its cost and complexity, and the realistic alternatives, as input to the team's risk acceptance recommendation
* Translate compliance requirements and risk advisory guidance from security engineers, Security Industry Specialists, and Audit Program Managers into actionable technical work for service teams and tooling partners
* Define success metrics for your programs and theme reporting for leadership reviews
* Own program communication, including status reports, path to green plans, and contributions to PR/FAQs, narratives, and OP1/OP2 planning

  
A day in the life  
Diverse Experiences  
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  
  
Why Amazon Security?  
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores  
  
Inclusive Team Culture  
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.  
  
Training & Career Growth  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

As a Security Officer – Surveillance, you will be the person spotting threats before they escalate in environments such as a security operations centers, call centers, parking gatehouses, etc.

**What’s in it for you:**  
**Schedule and Availability:**

* **Dynamic Scheduling:** Must have the absolute flexibility to work a rotating schedule. This includes mornings, evenings, overnights, weekends, and holidays to assist with event coverage.
* **Variable Hours:** Scheduled days on/off and total hours will fluctuate weekly based on specific site needs. Full-time hours are not guaranteed.

**Required Resume Keywords and Skills**  

* **To be considered for this role, your resume must explicitly demonstrate hands-on experience in the following core competencies:**
* Monitoring and Assessing Security-Related Events
* Researching and Validating Information
* Identifying Potential Threats or Impacts
* Concise Reporting (the ability to process complex information into precise, brief updates)
* Situational Awareness

**Required Experience and Qualifications**

* **Security Experience:** Minimum of 2 years of professional security intelligence experience.
* **GSOC Experience:** Minimum of 1 year working directly within a Global Security Operations Center (GSOC)

**Critical Position Notes**

* **Role Classification:** This is NOT a Cybersecurity, IT, or Helpdesk position. It is a physical security intelligence and operations role.
* **Location Requirements:** This position is 100% on-site. Candidates must be locally available in the area immediately for in-person interviews and the hiring process.
* Competitive hourly wage starting at **$32.00 / Hour** (DailyPay is available for GardaWorld employees!)
* A comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance plans, a 401(k) retirement savings plan with employer matching contributions, paid time off (PTO) policy, paid holidays, disability coverage, and life insurance options
* Career growth opportunities at GardaWorld
* Uniform provided at no cost

jobs.description:
**Description**

Leidos is seeking a Senior Supply Chain Risk Management Threat Intelligence Analyst to provide advanced, high-level technical and analytical support to the FAA’s Counterintelligence (CI) Supply Chain Risk Management (SCRM) program. The program is responsible for identifying, assessing, and mitigating foreign intelligence, nation-state, and cybersecurity threats to the FAA’s supply chain, critical infrastructure, and enterprise networks. Embedded as a senior leader within a 4-person team, this position focuses on threat landscapes, adversarial intent, and geopolitical vulnerability modeling. Providing independent, authoritative all-source intelligence analysis, the senior analyst designs analytic methodologies using Open Source Intelligence (OSINT) and corporate registries to uncover hidden Foreign Ownership, Control, or Influence (FOCI), technology transfer risks, and strategic threat trends targeting the aviation industrial base. This role oversees the evaluation of physical, technical, and personnel vulnerabilities, including sophisticated hardware/firmware threats and insider risks, to produce exquisite intelligence briefings that guide FAA executive leadership and empower the broader SCRM framework.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Conduct proactive threat analysis of foreign suppliers, third-party software developers, and hardware manufacturers to identify nation-state activity and strategic threat trends targeting the FAA.
* Utilize OSINT and corporate registries to screen prospective FAA vendors and evaluate the supply chain for Foreign Ownership, Control, or Influence (FOCI) indicators, foreign partnerships, and technology transfer threats.
* Monitor specialized threat feeds, nation-state activities, and geopolitical shifts to identify, evaluate, and mitigate strategic supply chain risks to the FAA.
* Support the FAA Insider Risk Program by identifying and analyzing personnel concerns, anomalous vendor behaviors, and internal vulnerabilities.
* Evaluate threat vectors including malicious hardware or software modifications, supply chain transit interdiction, and counterfeit electronic components.
* Synthesize complex data to produce clear, actionable Supplier Threat Profiles, Country Risk Profiles, link-analysis diagrams, and timely threat alerts/advisories for FAA program managers, technical teams, and executive decision-makers.
* Translate highly complex counterintelligence findings, technical hardware/software vulnerabilities, and macroeconomic geopolitical risks into exquisite intelligence briefings, dashboards, and executive decision packages tailored specifically for senior FAA leadership.
* Formulate performance metrics and program reports for executive leadership.
* Maintain critical operational and collaborative relationships with external stakeholders, including the FAA Chief Information Officer (CIO), Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA), Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI), Department of Homeland Security (DHS), and the broader Intelligence Community (IC).
* Coordinate and facilitate SCRM training and awareness campaigns for acquisition personnel and program offices.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Citizenship: U.S. Citizenship required.
* Clearance: Active Top Secret/SCI clearance is required.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Supply Chain, Intelligence Studies, National Security, Logistics, Data Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline. (Equivalent professional experience or specialized military/federal training may be substituted).
* Experience: 12+ years of professional experience as an Intelligence Analyst (All-Source, Cyber, Counterintelligence, or Open-Source Intelligence) or senior-level experience in third-party risk management (TPRM), Cyber Supply Chain Risk Management (C-SCRM), technical risk assessments, IT auditing, cybersecurity risk management, or infrastructure defense in a federal or highly regulated commercial environment.
* Analytical Capability: Work as a Subject Matter Expert in Supply Chain Risk Management. Proven experience using corporate registries, commercial databases, and OSINT techniques to analyze corporate structures, trace components, and evaluate FOCI.
* Technical Skills: Proficiency with due diligence or corporate intelligence platforms (e.g., Sayari, Altana, Interos, Maltego) and/or data modeling.
* Communication Skills: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a proven track record of translating complex intelligence and technical risk data into clear, concise executive briefs and formal written reports for non-technical stakeholders and delivering briefing materials to C-suite or flag-level leadership.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Completion of formal military or federal intelligence training courses focusing on threat network analysis or open-source collection.
* High proficiency with advanced OSINT search techniques, corporate filing retrieval systems, and international trade/shipping databases.
* Familiarity with the acquisition frameworks and an understanding of how supply chain intelligence feeds into federal procurement lifecycles.
* Prior experience supporting threat intelligence or counterintelligence infrastructure defense missions specifically for critical infrastructure or a federal agency.

jobs.title: Compliance Assurance Program Manager
jobs.description:
The global privacy regulatory landscape is not static, and the product and technical landscape at Meta changes multiple times daily to continue to meet and meet the needs of our more than 3.5 billion daily users on our platform. The Compliance Assurance Program Manager (CAPM) works at the center of privacy regulation, legal, business, product, and engineering to put our users' privacy at the center of everything we do.The Exam & Audit (E&A) team, part of Meta's Regulatory Compliance Program (RCP), manages Meta's regulatory examination and audit engagements. E&A connects internal stakeholders with external assessors and regulators. Its work includes delivering external assessor testing on time and at quality, defending the program's position on findings, and driving remediation of identified gaps. As the second line of defense, E&A also gives compliance advice and independent oversight of Meta's privacy safeguards. It challenges their design and effectiveness so that compliance becomes a catalyst for trusted, responsible product growth rather than a constraint.This role sits in the Third Party Risk Management (TPRM) domain. TPRM covers the safeguards that govern how third parties (developers, partners, vendors and service providers) access, use and protect Meta user data. The CAPM will be the second-line partner for these safeguards and will lead their readiness for independent assessment.We are looking for an individual contributor who brings audit, risk, and privacy expertise to serve as a trusted second-line advisor and assessment lead for third-party safeguards. As well as an individual contributor who tackles privacy complexities head-on, to help design and build an comprehensive privacy compliance program, while keeping our users and their privacy at the forefront of everything that we do.  
  
  

### **Compliance Assurance Program Manager Responsibilities:**

* Serve as the second-line compliance partner for TPRM safeguards across the whole third-party lifecycle: onboarding and due diligence, contract and platform terms, data access and API permissions, ongoing monitoring, enforcement, and offboarding and data deletion

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Opportunity Overview**

Northramp is seeking an experienced Senior Program Manager to lead a multi-phase Service Desk modernization engagement for a federal agency. The agency is consolidating distributed Level 1 IT support across its divisions into a single, centrally managed Service Desk delivered by a Managed Service Provider (MSP) and run on ServiceNow.

As the face of this effort, you will manage the full lifecycle of the Service Desk modernization and serve as a trusted advisor to key stakeholders and decision-makers across every phase of the engagement. You will lead a team of ITSM, knowledge management, and ServiceNow specialists, manage scope, schedule, risk and quality on a firm-fixed-price task order, and serve as the primary point of contact for agency IT leadership.

This role is part of Northramp’s integrated delivery model, where engineers and advisors work as one team to bring sound judgment, disciplined execution, and deep federal experience to high-stakes modernization programs.

This position is a proposed Key Personnel role and is contingent upon contract award. Selected candidates will be asked to sign a letter of intent and allow Northramp to submit their resume as part of our proposal.

**Location & Work Arrangement**

Hybrid, based in the Washington, DC metro area. On-site presence at client locations in Washington, DC is expected on a cadence aligned to program needs, including stakeholder workshops, governance meetings, and executive briefings. This role is not open to candidates outside the DC region.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Lead the engagement:** plan and run all phases, from project initiation and the 11-week current-state assessment through optional design, implementation, and post-launch advisory phases.
* **Manage scope, schedule, and risk:** maintain the integrated project plan and work breakdown structure, track milestones and deliverables, and manage risks, issues, and dependencies on a firm-fixed-price basis.
* **Direct the team:** coordinate the Lead ITSM/ITIL Consultant, Knowledge Management SME, ServiceNow Architect, and supporting staff so work moves in the right sequence and meets quality standards.
* **Serve as primary client contact:** run governance meetings and status reporting, and brief agency IT leadership on findings, decisions, and progress.
* **Engage stakeholders across divisions:** schedule and coordinate interviews and workshops, and secure buy-in from divisional teams whose support models are changing.
* **Guide organizational change:** oversee change management and communications so users and IT teams adopt the new service model with minimal disruption.
* **Oversee ServiceNow work:** make sure the operating model, knowledge base, and service catalog designs are built into ServiceNow configuration, testing, and training.
* **Support MSP readiness:** guide development of MSP requirements and transition plans that position the agency to select and oversee its provider.
* **Manage quality and compliance:** confirm deliverables meet agency standards, security requirements, and acceptance criteria.

 **Requirements**

**Required Qualifications**

* 10+ years of program/project management experience.
* 5+ years managing IT service transformation or MSP transition projects.
* PMP (Project Management Professional) or equivalent project management certification.
* Experience managing multi-phase consulting engagements.
* Experience working with federal or financial services institutions.
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
* Experience leading change management in complex organizations.
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Eligible to work in the United States.
* Based in the Washington, DC region.

**Desired Qualifications**

* Moderate to extensive experience implementing or modernizing ServiceNow functionality, especially ITSM in a service desk setting.
* Experience with ServiceNow upgrades, reimplementations, or legacy ITSM migrations.
* Familiarity with ServiceNow Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM) or similar tools.
* ServiceNow certification or ITIL 4 Foundation.
* 3+ years of experience working with the Federal Government or federal financial regulatory agencies.
* Experience with FISMA/NIST compliance environments.
* Experience managing engagements for federal financial regulators.

 **Benefits**  

* Employee Bonus Programs
* Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
* 401(k) Retirement Plan
* Basic Life, Voluntary Life, and AD&D Insurance
* Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Insurance
* Paid Time Off
* Paid Parental Leave
* Training and Professional Development
* Remote Work Opportunities
* Wellness Resources

Job description

At Qualtrics, we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high-performing teams, and design products people love. But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally. When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the mic and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.

The Technical Program Manager plays a pivotal part in Qualtrics' success by leading the design, delivery and ongoing success of customer’s experience programs, focused on driving measurable business impact. In this role, you will partner with customers throughout their lifecycle - from program delivery and onboarding to ongoing optimization, adoption and value realization. You will find success by blending exceptional customer and project management skills with a focus on technical platform adoption, renewals, and expansion. You will lead project teams to deliver complex programs within our specific Industry Verticals and Region, ensuring your customers deepen and broaden their usage of the platform. By influencing customers to shape their feedback programs and being resourceful when facing challenges, you will drive leading indicators of success, value realization, and Net ARR growth.

**How You’ll Grow**

* Define and execute your strategy for retaining, maturing and expanding customer accounts; including assessing customer usage and implementing new capabilities to enhance their programs
* Develop success plans aligned with customer business goals and technology roadmaps
* Monitor customer health, platform utilization and adoption metrics to identify opportunities for increased value
* Contribute to a culture of accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement to drive high quality customer outcomes

**Provide Technical & Execution Expertise**

**Successful Execution**

* Time to Value for customers following delivery of new capabilities (measured by level of consumption 60 days following go-live milestone)

**Things You'll Do**

* **Portfolio Leadership:** Own the success of a portfolio of customer accounts, serving as the primary technology advisor throughout the customer lifecycle
* **Portfolio Performance:** Monitor portfolio performance using customer health, adoption, maturity and value realisation to proactively manage risk and identify growth opportunities
* **Account Growth & Maturity:** Define strategy to expand program adoption and maturity across our customer accounts, driving Net ARR and portfolio performance
* **Strategic Project Management:** Partner with customers to provide expertise leading to the alignment of project goals and timely execution
* **Risk & Quality Management:** Plan, monitor, and mitigate project risks while developing quality management plans aligned with business requirements
* **Cross-functional Collaboration:** Collaborate with internal teams to support your customer’s experience

PotomacWave is looking for a Senior Facilities Project/Program Manager to join our team supporting a Federal client in Washington, DC. The individual supporting this position will provide integrated project management, space and workforce planning, design-requirements coordination, network and telecommunications infrastructure project coordination, and related advisory and assistance services.  
  
This role will support assigned construction, renovation, maintenance, facilities upgrade, infrastructure, and office-move projects. This includes workforce planning, space programming, Directorate design requirements, architecture and engineering, construction, furniture and equipment, secure and nonsecure network and telecommunications services, physical security, records, logistics, and post-occupancy support.  
  
**Responsibilities**:

* Provide a single, integrated management capability for assigned projects and timely, decision-ready information on scope, schedule, resources, risks, issues, dependencies, changes, and performance.
* Coordinate facilities work with secure and nonsecure information technology and telecommunications requirements throughout planning, design, construction, move, testing, and occupancy.
* Serve as the principal point of contact for assigned projects; define objectives, scope, requirements, constraints, assumptions, deliverables, and acceptance criteria; and maintain fit-for-purpose project plans.
* Manage schedules, resources, cost tracking, requirements, changes, risks, issues, stakeholders, communications, quality, records, transition, and closeout.
* Maintain integrated schedules showing dependencies, milestones, decisions, responsible organizations, critical-path and long-lead activities, testing, acceptance, moves, and occupancy; monitor performance and promptly report forecast variances.

* Coordinate authorized stakeholders and vendors supporting construction, maintenance, furniture, equipment, telephones, networks, printers, audiovisual services, and other project needs. Integrate their activities into the schedule without providing contractual direction.
* Prepare management briefings and maintain complete project artifacts and records. Support completion on schedule, within authorized resources, and in accordance with approved requirements.

Support authorized Government officials in identifying and evaluating potential satellite SCIF alternatives; developing requirements and comparative analyses; coordinating site assessments and design inputs; and maintaining integrated implementation, readiness, contingency, and move plans.

* Bachelor’s degree in facilities management, engineering, architecture, construction management, information technology, telecommunications, project management, business administration, or a related field from an accredited institution

Overview:

AMERICAN SYSTEMS, a **100% employee-owned** federal contractor, is seeking a **Data Steward and Data Analyst** to support mission-focused data integration efforts in **Arlington, VA**. You will help transform complex mission data into **secure, trusted, discoverable, and reusable data products** that support Government decision-making and operations.

The ideal candidate is a **collaborative, detail-oriented data professional** who can balance mission needs with sound **data governance** and security practices. You bring strong analytical judgment, communicate clearly with both technical and mission stakeholders, and take ownership of **solving complex data challenges in a dynamic, classified environment**.

**\*\*\* This job requisition is for potential upcoming work at AMERICAN SYSTEMS and does not represent a current opening. Qualified candidates will be contacted when the work/funding becomes available. \*\*\***

Responsibilities:

As a **Sr. Data Steward and Data Analyst** with AMERICAN SYSTEMS, you will:

* Analyze mission data sources and requests, including **format, volume, sensitivity, classification, ownership, authoritative source, consumers, and operational dependencies**.
* Develop and maintain **data-source profiles**, including schemas, data dictionaries, metadata, lineage, quality rules, access tags, catalog entries, and acceptance criteria.
* Support data governance and data-management activities that improve **data discoverability, reuse, controlled sharing, interoperability, and mission usability**.
* Support the design, analysis, and implementation of data-management solutions, including **data modeling, relational database analysis, metadata repositories, data mapping, and transformational analysis**.
* Partner with Government stakeholders, data owners, software teams, platform teams, security personnel, compliance stakeholders, and operations teams to validate data use and handling requirements.
* Document **classification, releasability, retention, audit, masking, and access-control** requirements for mission data.
* Support **attribute-based access control (ABAC)** implementation through attribute mapping, metadata tagging, controlled sharing, and secure data-product publication.
* Develop and maintain technical documentation, including **data architectures, interface control documents, source-to-target mappings, access-control plans, test plans, validation procedures, and runbooks**.
* Perform **data profiling, reconciliation, validation, anomaly identification, trend analysis, and data-quality assessments**.
* Define and track data-quality metrics, including **availability, completeness, timeliness, lineage accuracy, schema conformance, catalog readiness, and usability**.
* Support integration and test activities by validating **data movement, schema implementation, metadata tagging, access controls, quality rules, and audit requirements**.
* Identify and recommend practical improvements related to **data quality, standardization, discoverability, reuse, and operational performance**.
* Prepare clear technical analyses, data profiles, test results, and stakeholder-ready deliverables.

Qualifications:

* **Active Top Secret security clearance** with **SCI** and **SAP eligibility**.
* Bachelor’s degree in **data science, information systems, computer science, analytics, statistics, engineering, or a related technical discipline**.
* **5 to 7 years of related experience** in data analysis, data stewardship, data governance, database analysis, data integration, database development, or a related technical field.
* Current **DoD 8140 IAT Level II baseline certification**, such as **CompTIA Security+ CE**, or another qualifying IAT Level II certification.
* **Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst Associate**, **Tableau certification**, or an equivalent **data analytics certification**.
* Experience documenting **data sources, schemas, data dictionaries, metadata, lineage, data-quality rules, catalog entries, data tags, and acceptance criteria**.
* Experience working with **structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data**.
* Experience with **SQL**, relational databases, data profiling, data-quality analysis, metadata management, source-to-target mapping, and dashboards.
* Working knowledge of **data governance, lifecycle management, classification handling, access controls, releasability, retention, audit requirements, and secure data sharing**.
* Familiarity with **ABAC**, attribute mapping, metadata tagging, controlled sharing, and data-masking concepts.
* Ability to work independently, develop sound approaches to assigned work, and deliver practical solutions to complex data challenges.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

**Helpful Qualifications**

* **DAMA CDMP Associate** certification, or an equivalent **data management or data governance certification**.
* Experience supporting **enterprise data products** or mission data integration workflows.
* Experience with SQL, data profiling, data quality analysis, data dictionaries, metadata management, source-to-target mapping, dashboards, and relational databases

jobs.description:
**The team youll be working with:**  
Senior Threat Intelligence Analyst
  
  
UK Security Practice | Birmingham / UK-based with flexible hybrid working | Specialist and team lead
  
  
Role summary
  
  
The Senior Threat Intelligence Analyst leads the delivery of high-quality cyber threat intelligence for clients and the NTT DATA UK Security Practice. The role combines hands-on analysis with day-to-day leadership of threat intelligence analysts, setting priorities, assuring analytical quality, developing team capability and translating intelligence into decisions across security operations, incident response, threat hunting, vulnerability management and risk leadership.
  
  
The postholder operates with substantial autonomy, manages complex assignments, influences technical and non-technical stakeholders, and is accountable for the quality, timeliness, legality and ethical integrity of intelligence outputs.
  
  
**What youll be doing:**  
Team leadership and delivery management
  
  

* Lead, allocate and coordinate the work of a threat intelligence team; set clear objectives, priorities, quality expectations and delivery deadlines.
* Provide technical supervision, peer review and escalation support while enabling analysts to exercise appropriate autonomy and judgement.
* Coach and mentor team members through structured feedback, knowledge sharing, skills development plans and support for professional certification.
* Manage workload, service risks, dependencies and competing client priorities; escalate material issues with clear options and recommendations.
* Establish and monitor delivery standards, analytical tradecraft, source handling, quality assurance and reusable intelligence processes.
* Act as deputy or workstream lead when required, representing the capability in client, operational and leadership forums.

Threat intelligence direction, collection and analysis
  
  

* Define and maintain priority intelligence requirements and collection plans aligned to client assets, business exposure, threat scenarios and decision needs.
* Direct and conduct research across OSINT, commercial and government feeds, technical telemetry, malware reporting, trusted sharing communities, underground sources and other lawful intelligence sources.
* Analyse threat actors, campaigns, malware, infrastructure, indicators of compromise and tactics, techniques and procedures using structured analytical techniques.
* Assess source reliability, information credibility, confidence and intelligence gaps; distinguish verified reporting from analytical judgement.
* Produce strategic, operational and tactical intelligence explaining relevance, likely impact and recommended action rather than simply reproducing threat data.
* Maintain awareness of geopolitical, sector, regulatory and technology developments affecting UK and international clients.

Intelligence production and stakeholder influence
  
  

* Own and assure executive threat briefs, campaign assessments, actor profiles, vulnerability intelligence, sector reports and incident intelligence packages.
* Brief senior leaders, clients, SOC teams, incident responders, detection engineers, vulnerability teams and risk stakeholders using language appropriate to each audience.
* Present defensible conclusions, confidence levels, assumptions, intelligence gaps and recommended actions; respond constructively to challenge and alternative hypotheses.
* Build trusted relationships with internal teams, clients, government bodies, industry groups and intelligence-sharing communities while protecting sensitive sources and information.

Operational integration and capability improvement
  
  

* Integrate intelligence into SIEM, SOAR, TIP, threat hunting, detection engineering, incident response and vulnerability prioritisation workflows.
* Guide the use of MITRE ATT, STIX/TAXII, the intelligence cycle, Diamond Model and suitable analytical techniques.
* Develop and quality-assure correlation rules, watchlists, enrichment logic, automation and playbooks, with controls to limit false positives and unmanaged operational impact.
* Use lessons learned, stakeholder feedback and measurable outcomes to improve collection, analysis, dissemination and intelligence-led decisions.
* Support service development, proposals, client workshops and the evolution of NTT DATA threat intelligence methods and offerings.

**What experience youll bring:**  

* 3-5 years practical experience delivering cyber threat intelligence, including complex assessments and review of other analysts work.
* Demonstrable experience leading, coordinating or technically supervising a team, workstream or intelligence function and managing delivery through others.

This is a highly visible role requiring strong programme delivery skills, global stakeholder management experience, and hands-on expertise implementing enterprise background screening solutions across complex, multi-country environments.

jobs.title: Customer Deployment Manager
jobs.description:
**About Endra**

Every building is designed twice. The architect shapes what you see. MEP engineers design everything that makes it work: the power, air and water behind every hospital, data centre and home. It's a $150 billion industry still run on manual work and decades-old tools, and it's running out of engineers just as the world needs more buildings than ever.

We're building the platform that changes that. Endra's takes over the repetitive work so engineers can do what they're trained for: judgment and design. Some of the world's most respected engineering firms, including AtkinsRéalis, Ramboll, Buro Happold, Hoare Lea, Tetra Tech, AFRY and Rejlers, already build with us.

Since 2024, we've raised $75 million from Andreessen Horowitz, Notion Capital and Norrsken VC, and grown into a team across Stockholm, Zurich, London, New York and San Francisco. We're early, moving fast and setting out to change how the world's buildings get designed.

We're looking for people who care deeply about their craft, take ownership of complex problems, push us to think bigger, and are driven to create something with lasting impact.

**About the role**

For us, a signed contract is the starting line. The moment a customer signs, Customer Deployment takes over, and our job is to make Endra the way their engineers actually work as soon as possible.

As Customer Deployment Manager, you'll own that journey for some of our most important customers: large engineering consultancies with many offices, hundreds of engineers, and a long list of stakeholders who all need to say yes. You'll be the project lead for each rollout. You set up the structure, drive adoption, clear the roadblocks, and make the value impossible to miss.

You'll work hand in hand with our product specialists who are MEP engineers: they bring the MEP depth, you bring the structure and the commercial lens. Together you'll help engineers who have worked the same way for decades adopt a new one.

**What you'll do**.

* **Own onboarding and rollout.** Lead on-site and remote onboarding with our product specialists so MEP engineers get up and running fast and deliver real results using Endra on their very first project. You own the plan and the milestones, and you keep every stakeholder moving.
* **Work every stakeholder.** Cover everyone from the CEO and heads of discipline to BIM managers, IT and the engineers on the project. Keep them involved at the right moments, and turn early users into champions who train their colleagues.
* **Measure and report the wins.** Agree on success criteria with each customer, track adoption and account health, and act on risk early. Turn the results into clear wins for their leadership and for Endra.
* **Clear the roadblocks.** Spot what's stalling early, whether it's technical, organizational, or a skeptical team. Bring in the right people and see it through.
* **Find the next opportunity.** Uncover new teams, offices and use cases, and support account managers in further growing the customer accounts.
* **Shape the product.** Bring structured insight from the field to product and engineering, so what we build next is what customers need.
* **Build the playbook.** Our deployment function is young. You'll define how Endra rolls out, measures and reports, and set the standard the team scales on.

**Who you are**

* You've run or played a key role in enterprise software rollouts, with 3–5 years of client-facing experience in customer success, implementation or management consulting, ideally in a complex, expert-driven industry.
* You've driven change management before and know that getting a large organization onto new technology is as much about people as about software.
* You're structured and organized, and you stay calm when there are many moving parts.
* You take ownership, and your track record shows it in results delivered and responsibilities that grew.
* You have commercial instinct. You know adoption drives renewal and expansion, and you think about the customer's business case, not only usage numbers.
* You're an excellent communicator, in writing and in the room, and a team player who makes the people around you better.
* You’re comfortable building as you go, improving a playbook rather than just following it.

**How we think and work**

* Less is more: We simplify and ship smaller, fast.
* Build the right things: We listen carefully and build what users actually need.
* Velocity & Quality: We build things that last, but we don’t perfect them forever.
* Trust & Collaboration: Strong opinions, loosely held.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary and equity.
* Employee-friendly equity terms.
* Private health insurance.
* Regular team events and off-sites.
* An inspiring, ambitious, and global work environment.

**Ready to move the needle?**

Do you feel this is your opportunity to do your most meaningful work and reshape an entire industry? Let's talk!

jobs.title: Data Analyst

We’re looking for a Data Analyst who’s ready to dive into new tools, smarter technologies, and fresh ways of working as we tackle today’s challenges and prepare for tomorrow. * Design and interrogation of databases; carrying out data transformations and liaising with the business to improve our ways of working.
* Supporting the business and working with stakeholders to design, build, and maintain a range of reports.
* Becoming a key point of contact, collaborating with colleagues, and engaging with stakeholders to further our objectives. You will inform colleagues on operational decisions.
* Maintaining data quality and ensure data is secure and properly utilised in line with the GDPR.
* Bridge the gap between the business and data, using analytical thinking to solve business problems to generate value, presented through clear presentations and insight.

**Working pattern:** 36 Hours Monday – Friday (Every Tuesday 1 day a week in office)

If you’re looking for a sustainable and successful career where you can make a daily difference to millions of people’s lives while helping to protect the world of water for future generations, we’ll be here to support you every step of the way. Together, we can build a better future for our customers, our region, and our planet.

Real purpose, real support, real opportunities. Come and join the Thames Water family. Why choose us? Learn more.

We’re committed to being a great, diverse, and inclusive place to work. We welcome applications from everyone and want to ensure you feel supported throughout the recruitment process. If you need any adjustments, whether that’s extra time, accessible formats, or anything else just let us know, we’re here to help and support.

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.

Qualifications

jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

DXC Technology is committed to building diverse, inclusive teams. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and particularly encourage interest from women, underrepresented groups, and neurodivergent candidates. We offer reasonable adjustments throughout the hiring process and are dedicated to creating a supportive, accessible environment for everyone.

**Hardware Asset Management (HAM) Data Analyst**

**Location: Farnborough (onsite 5 days per week)**

**Due to the nature of the work and the customers we support, the successful candidate must be eligible to meet UK Government and contractual personnel security requirements, including the applicable residency requirements for the role, and have the right to work in the United Kingdom. Some roles may also be subject to nationality requirements where these are necessary to meet UK Government or contractual security obligations.**

We are looking for an experienced Hardware Asset Management (HAM) Data Analyst to take ownership of the quality, accuracy and integrity of hardware asset data across the full asset lifecycle. This is a key role within the IT Asset Management function, providing trusted data to support financial, contractual, operational, security and compliance decisions. You will work across Asset Management, Configuration Management, Procurement, Finance, IT Operations and suppliers to ensure hardware asset information is accurate, reconciled, auditable and continuously improved. This is not simply a data entry role. You will proactively identify data quality issues, reconcile information across multiple systems, investigate discrepancies and drive improvements in the maturity and reliability of the hardware asset estate.

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Own and maintain the quality and integrity of hardware asset records across ITAM tools, CMDBs and associated systems.
* Perform regular data quality audits and reconciliations, identifying duplicates, missing records, ghost assets, unmanaged assets and data discrepancies.
* Reconcile asset information across ITAM, CMDB, discovery, procurement and financial systems.
* Maintain accurate asset data throughout the full lifecycle, from procurement and deployment through to redeployment and disposal.
* Produce asset reports, dashboards and data quality KPIs covering inventory, lifecycle status, warranties, EOL/EOS, utilisation and compliance.
* Support financial reconciliation between the IT asset register and Finance's fixed asset register, including capitalisation, depreciation and cost information.
* Maintain accurate procurement, vendor, warranty and support contract information.
* Support internal and external audits, providing accurate data, evidence and audit trails.
* Work with operational and technical teams to improve discovery coverage and resolve data discrepancies.
* Develop and maintain data standards, validation rules, naming conventions and governance processes.
* Identify opportunities for automation and process improvement to reduce manual effort and improve data accuracy.
* Provide clear, actionable insight and recommendations to HAM/ITAM leadership and wider stakeholders.

**What you'll bring**

  

* Experience in IT Asset Management, Hardware Asset Management, CMDB or Configuration Management data roles.
* Strong data analysis skills with experience working with large, complex datasets from multiple sources.
* Experience using ITAM or asset management tools such as ServiceNow ITAM/HAM, Flexera, Snow, Ivanti or equivalent.
* Strong understanding of the hardware asset lifecycle, from procurement through to disposal.
* Experience reconciling data across ITAM, CMDB, discovery, procurement and financial systems.
* Advanced Excel skills and experience with reporting/visualisation tools such as Power BI, SQL or equivalent.
* Experience producing asset reports, dashboards and data quality metrics.
* Excellent attention to detail and a strong focus on data accuracy and integrity.
* Understanding of data governance, data standards, validation and audit requirements.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain data issues and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Desirable**

  

* IAITAM certification such as CHAMP, CSAM or CITAM.
* ITIL 4 Foundation or equivalent.
* Experience with ServiceNow HAM/ITAM and automated discovery tools such as ServiceNow Discovery, Tanium, SCCM, Qualys or Lansweeper.
* Knowledge of ISO 19770 IT Asset Management standards.
* Understanding of financial asset management, including depreciation, capitalisation, book value and TCO.
* Experience supporting audits and compliance activities.
* Knowledge of environmental disposal requirements such as WEEE.
* SQL, PowerShell or scripting experience.
* Experience working in secure, regulated or defence environments.

At DXC Technology, we believe strong connections and community are key to our success. Our work model prioritizes in-person collaboration while offering flexibility to support wellbeing, productivity, individual work styles, and life circumstances. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager - Infrastructure
jobs.description:
WSP is seeking a highly experienced Senior Project Manager - Infrastructure to support the delivery of major infrastructure and masterplan development projects in Dubai. This role will be responsible for leading multidisciplinary project teams, managing client relationships, and overseeing the successful delivery of projects in line with scope, schedule, budget, and quality objectives.

The successful candidate will have a strong technical engineering background, preferably in Civil Engineering, together with proven experience working for leading international engineering consultancies on large-scale infrastructure and masterplan development projects within Dubai. The role requires an experienced project leader with excellent stakeholder management skills, commercial awareness, and a strong track record of delivering complex multidisciplinary infrastructure programmes.

As part of the Transport & Infrastructure business, the Senior Project Manager will play a key role in delivering some of the region's most significant infrastructure and land development projects while supporting business growth and maintaining the highest standards of project delivery excellence.

  

Project Management & Delivery

* Lead the planning, coordination, and delivery of large-scale infrastructure and masterplan development projects.
* Manage multidisciplinary design and project delivery teams across all project phases.
* Develop project execution plans, schedules, resource forecasts, and delivery strategies.
* Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and in accordance with quality standards.
* Monitor project performance and implement corrective actions where required.
Coordinate with technical teams to ensure efficient and integrated project delivery.  

Client Relationship & Stakeholder Management

* Act as a primary point of contact for clients and key stakeholders.
* Develop and maintain strong client relationships, ensuring high levels of client satisfaction.
* Manage communications with government authorities, developers, contractors, and project partners.
* Lead project meetings, progress reviews, and stakeholder engagement activities.
Support Project Directors in managing executive-level client interactions and project governance requirements.  

Commercial & Financial Management

* Monitor project budgets, forecasts, resource utilisation, and commercial performance.
* Support contract administration, change management, and commercial reporting activities.
* Manage project risks and ensure mitigation measures are implemented.
* Contribute to profitability targets through effective project planning and resource management.
Assist in managing project variations, claims, and contractual obligations.  

Technical Leadership & Coordination

* Provide technical leadership and oversight on infrastructure and masterplan development projects.
* Ensure engineering solutions are aligned with client requirements, regulatory expectations, and industry best practices.
* Coordinate multidisciplinary design inputs and project deliverables.
* Support technical reviews and quality assurance processes.
Promote innovation, value engineering, and continuous improvement initiatives.  

Governance, Risk & Compliance

* Ensure compliance with project management processes, company procedures, and governance frameworks.
* Support project risk identification, management, and reporting activities.
* Maintain high standards of quality, safety, and technical excellence.
* Participate in project audits, reviews, and lessons learned activities.
* Ensure contractual and regulatory requirements are met throughout project delivery.

  

* Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or a related engineering discipline.
* Minimum 15+ years of experience within engineering consultancy, infrastructure project delivery, or major development programmes.
* Recent project experience in Dubai, preferably past 5 years.
* Proven experience working with leading international engineering consultancies.
* Demonstrated experience managing large-scale infrastructure masterplan and land development projects in Dubai.
* Strong technical engineering background, preferably in civil infrastructure projects.
* Proven client-facing experience and ability to manage relationships with government entities, developers, and key stakeholders.
* Experience leading multidisciplinary project teams and coordinating complex project deliverables.
* Strong understanding of project management principles, project controls, commercial management, and risk management.
* Experience administering consultancy contracts and managing project budgets, schedules, and resources.
* Strong communication, leadership, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
PMP certification, Chartered Engineer status, or equivalent professional accreditation is desirable.  

As well as rewarding you with competitive pay, WSP offers standard benefits including first class medical cover, paid professional subscriptions.

Be you, be happy - we strive to have a friendly and inclusive culture which respects and maximizes the contribution individuals can bring to WSP. We recognise the benefits that people with varying backgrounds and experiences can bring. Here at WSP we positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of gender, race, disability, age, religion or belief, marital status, pregnancy or maternity/paternity. We will interview all disabled applicants who meet the essential criteria.

Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.

Join our close-knit community of talented individuals who share your passion for making a positive impact. Our global team includes more than 69,000 employees, working together to make a difference in communities both close to home and around the world.

With us, you can. Apply today.

**About Varda**
---------------

Low Earth orbit is open for business. Varda is accelerating the development of commercial space infrastructure, from in-orbit pharmaceutical processing to reliable and economical reentry capsules. **Varda's W-Series vehicles are built, designed, and operated by Varda in-house, including the pharmaceutical processing payloads, the capsules, the C-PICA heat shields, and the satellite buses.**

From life-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. Varda is accelerating innovation in the orbital economy by creating both the products and infrastructure needed so space can directly benefit life on Earth. Our mission is to expand the economic bounds of humankind.

Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. Varda was founded in January 2021 by Will Bruey and Delian Asparouhov with significant backing from world class investors including Khosla Ventures, Lux Capital, Founders Fund, Caffeinated Capital, General Catalyst, and Also Capital.

Varda is headquartered in El Segundo, California, where we have offices and a production facility where our vehicles, equipment, and materials are built, integrated, and tested. Varda also has offices in Washington, DC and Huntsville, AL.

Varda is manufacturing medicines in orbit and flying government missions that bring hardware back through hypersonic reentry. It's some of the most ambitious work happening anywhere, and it only happens if the people, facilities, information, and hardware behind it are protected. That's the job. You would be the one who makes Varda's security program real.

Physical security operations are outside the scope of this role. We plan to hire a dedicated Physical Security Manager after this position, so you can focus on what you do best.

* Control classified information and material from marking, receipt, storage, and dissemination through inventory, transfer, approved transmission, and destruction when authorized.

* Coordinate SCI nominations, program access requests, and customer-required polygraph scheduling when applicable, and verify eligibility and need-to-know before access is granted.
* Partner with HR on cleared employee onboarding and offboarding, and maintain clearance rosters, access records, personnel security files, and briefing acknowledgments.
* Brief the team: initial, annual, refresher, foreign travel, and termination briefings, plus program indoctrinations and debriefings with authorized officials.
* Process incoming and outgoing visit authorizations and certifications, and verify visitor clearance and access requirements.

* Plan ahead by forecasting clearance needs with hiring and program teams, and track metrics on processing status, overdue reporting, training completion, and inspection findings.

jobs.description:
Overview:

UCI Health is one of California's largest academic health systems and the clinical enterprise of the University of California, Irvine. Established on July 1, 1976, UCI Health has grown into a 1,461-bed health system that includes UCI Health - Orange, UCI Health - Irvine, four Community Network hospitals and a growing network of ambulatory care centers across Orange and Los Angeles counties.
  
  
As Orange County’s only academic health systems, UCI Health is home to the only National Cancer Institute-designated comprehensive cancer center based in the county, the region’s only American College of Surgeons-verified Level I adult and Level II pediatric trauma center, American College of Emergency Physicians Gold Level 1 Geriatric Emergency Department and a nationally recognized regional burn center verified by the American Burn Association. Powered by UC Irvine, UCI Health serves 5.6 million people across Orange County, western Riverside County and southeast Los Angeles County through excellence in patient care, research and medical education.

Responsibilities: **Position Summary:**

The Business Intelligence Analyst supports Ambulatory Imaging Operations and provides system-wide analytic support for Imaging Services across all modalities, departments, and sites. Aggregates data from Strata, API, Genesys, and other source systems and builds standard and ad hoc reports and Power BI and Tableau dashboards covering productivity, volume, staffing, capacity, and financial performance. Serves as the data and analytics resource for the Imaging Services team, translating data into recommendations that support operational decisions. Partners with Finance, Revenue Cycle, and Information Services to ensure data validity and consistent metric definitions. In addition, is responsible for the accuracy and management of the Charge Data Master (CDM) (Rate Schedule) analysis and resolving billing and rate deck problems.

Qualifications: **Required Qualifications:**  

* Working knowledge of business intelligence and data visualization tools, including Power BI and Tableau

* Thorough knowledge of business intelligence functions, analytics, industry standards & best practices

* Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills to manage complex information, assess problems, and develop effective solutions

* Proficient knowledge of business and data process analysis functions

* Must understand basic budget, billing, and cost accounting functions

* Must possess the skill, knowledge, and ability essential to the successful completion of job duties

* Must have a working knowledge of Current Procedural Terminology (CPT) and Diagnosis (ICD-10) codes

* Must be familiar with all administrative aspects of Radiology, including Reception, Registration, Film Library, and the duties of technical staff in all modalities

* Minimum 4 years’ experience working in progressively more complex analytical roles

* Minimum 2 years of experience with healthcare operations data

* Experience aggregating and analyzing data from multiple source systems, such as Strata, API, and Genesys

* Excellent computer skills and experience with a proficient working knowledge of Microsoft Excel

* Effective verbal and written communication skills in English

* Bachelor's Degree, or equivalent education and experience

* Able to translate complex data and information and communicate it simply and effectively to constituents.

* Ability to perform basic performance tuning to optimize queries to meet user needs

* Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships within the work unit and across the Health System

* Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with patients, families, as well as internal and external stakeholders at all level across the health system

* 2 years of experience PowerBI and Tableau

  
**Preferred Qualifications:**  

* Master’s degree

* Lean Six Sigma Certification

* Knowledge of UCI policies and procedures

* Ability to read and understand HL7 interface language

  
  
**Total Rewards**

We offer a wealth of benefits to make working at UCI even more rewarding. These benefits may include medical insurance, sick and vacation time, retirement savings plans, and access to a number of discounts and perks. Please utilize the links listed here to learn more about our compensation practices and benefits.

At **CesiumAstro**, we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team.

We are looking to add a **Senior Supply Chain Operations Analyst** to our team. In this role you will perform complex supplier management and supply chain analysis activities involving supplier qualification, Approved Supplier List (ASL) governance, due diligence, compliance, performance monitoring, and operational reporting. This role applies strong supply chain knowledge to evaluate supplier capabilities, assess operational risks, analyze performance data, and develop scalable processes that strengthen supplier oversight and supply chain effectiveness. Through established analytical methods and professional judgment, the Senior Supply Chain Operations Analyst supports supplier development, supply continuity, regulatory compliance, and operational improvements.

Working cross-functionally with Strategic Sourcing, Supplier Quality, Engineering, Compliance, Manufacturing, Operations, and other business teams, this role supports supplier qualification, performance management, risk assessment, and process improvement initiatives that strengthen supplier reliability, operational readiness, and organizational growth.

### **JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Maintain and improve the enterprise Approved Supplier List (ASL), including supplier qualifications, certifications, approved capabilities, manufacturing locations, and supporting records.
* Develop standardized supplier onboarding, qualification, approval, and requalification processes that strengthen supplier governance and data accuracy.
* Coordinate with Strategic Sourcing, Supplier Quality, Engineering, and Compliance to evaluate supplier capabilities, support approval decisions, and maintain supplier qualification requirements.
* Conduct supplier assessments, site visits, and operational due diligence to evaluate manufacturing capabilities, production capacity, operational readiness, and future growth requirements.
* Review supplier certifications, regulatory requirements, contractual obligations, and quality standards to identify compliance gaps and potential supply chain risks.
* Track supplier risks, assessment findings, corrective actions, and resolution activities while coordinating with functional stakeholders to address identified concerns.
* Support implementation of a structured Grow, Sustain, and Exit supplier management framework based on supplier capabilities, performance, risk, and business requirements.
* Analyze supplier performance involving quality, on-time delivery (OTD), responsiveness, capacity, and supply continuity to identify trends and improvement opportunities.
* Prepare supplier scorecards, performance dashboards, and recurring supplier reviews while coordinating improvement plans and supplier transitions as needed.
* Analyze supplier, procurement, inventory, and operational data to identify performance gaps, supply constraints, material risks, and improvement opportunities.
* Design scalable supplier governance workflows, reporting dashboards, data validation controls, and performance measures that strengthen operational visibility and consistency.
* Partner with Enterprise Systems and cross-functional stakeholders to implement improvements to supplier data management, ERP workflows, reporting processes, and supply chain operations.

### **JOB REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Operations Management, Engineering, Logistics, or a related field with 5–8 years of related experience, or Master's degree in a related field with 3–6 years of related experience in supplier management, supplier qualification, supply chain operations, procurement, supplier quality, compliance, supply chain analytics, or a related discipline.
* Strong knowledge of supplier management, supplier qualification, supply chain operations, procurement, and supplier performance practices.
* In-depth understanding of Approved Supplier List (ASL) governance, supplier onboarding, due diligence, qualification requirements, and supplier lifecycle management.
* Proficiency in evaluating supplier capabilities, certifications, manufacturing capacity, operational readiness, compliance requirements, and supply chain risks.
* Understanding of supplier performance management, scorecards, on-time delivery (OTD), quality metrics, corrective actions, and supply continuity requirements.
* Experience applying supplier governance processes, analyzing operational data, developing dashboards, and supporting improvements to supplier management workflows.
* Knowledge of AS9100, ISO 9001, ITAR/EAR, DFARS, ERP systems, Power BI, SQL, and supplier compliance practices within aerospace and defense manufacturing environments.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, and Teams.
* Enterprise resource planning (ERP) and supplier management applications, e.g. Acumatica, SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, or equivalent platforms.
