jobs.title: Contact Strategy Analyst
jobs.description:
**Position Summary:**

Responsible for supporting the oversight of the systems, processes, and analytics that enable revenue growth and operational efficiency within the Consumer Direct lending channel. This role will collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Operations teams to optimize the revenue cycle, improve pipeline visibility, and support business performance. The Analyst will support forecasting, reporting and adoption of AI/ML tools and processes that support loan officers and sales leaders in meeting revenue targets.

**Responsibilities:**

  

* Analyze large, complex datasets to generate actionable insights that drive revenue growth, improve contact strategies, optimize lead distribution, and enhance unit economics.
* Develop and maintain predictive models, AI/ML driven analytics, and reporting solutions to support business decision making, forecasting, pricing strategies, and lead performance measurement.
* Conduct ongoing pricing and competitive market analyses, recommending adjustments to improve conversion rates, profitability, and market positioning.
* Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Operations teams to understand business needs and deliver data-driven solutions that improve production and efficiency.
* Establish, standardize, and document revenue operations processes, workflows, and governance practices to support scalable growth and operational excellence.
* Support lead management, marketing attribution, sales enablement, and customer acquisition initiatives through advanced analytics and performance reporting.
* Collaborate with Finance to validate revenue forecasts, commission plans, business cases, and key performance metrics.
* Leverage mortgage industry knowledge to analyze revenue funnels, lead economics, customer acquisition costs, and sales performance trends.
* Stay informed on emerging trends, technologies, and best practices in revenue operations, analytics, AI/ML, and the mortgage industry.

**Requirements**

  

* Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Business Analytic, Data Analytic or related field preferred.
* Minimum of two (2) + years’ experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or Business Operations, preferably within mortgage lending, financial services, or banking.
* Knowledge of mortgage lending products, pipeline management, and loan officer performance metrics a plus.
* Excellent analytical skills with expertise in Excel, SQL, or BI tools.
* Exceptional verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills.

**Why work for #teamloanDepot:**

  

* Aggressive compensation package based on experience and skill set.
* Inclusive, diverse, and collaborative culture where people from all backgrounds can thrive.
* Work with other passionate, purposeful, and customer-centric people.
* Extensive internal growth and professional development opportunities including tuition reimbursement.
* Comprehensive benefits package including Medical/Dental/Vision.
* Wellness program to support both mental and physical health.
* Generous paid time off for both exempt and non-exempt positions.

**About loanDepot:**

loanDepot (NYSE: LDI) is a digital commerce company committed to serving its customers throughout the home ownership journey. Since its launch in 2010, loanDepot has revolutionized the mortgage industry with a digital-first approach that makes it easier, faster, and less stressful to purchase or refinance a home. Today, loanDepot enables customers to achieve the American dream of homeownership through a broad suite of lending and real estate services that simplify one of life's most complex transactions. With headquarters in Southern California and offices nationwide, loanDepot is committed to serving the communities in which its team lives and works through a variety of local, regional, and national philanthropic efforts.

Base salary is one piece of our total rewards package and is structured within a range so you can progress as you grow in the role. For this position, the anticipated annual base salary range is $66,000 to $91,000 nationally. In certain high-cost geographic markets (CA), the anticipated annual base salary range is $76,000 to $104,500. Actual compensation will depend on your skills, experience, qualifications, and the work location tied to our geographic pay structure.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity in our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

jobs.title: Ticketing Operations Analyst - Product Ops
jobs.description:
AXS connects fans with the artists and teams they love. Each year we sell millions of tickets to thousands of incredible events – from concerts and festivals to sports and theater – at some of the most iconic venues in the world. Since our founding in 2011, we've consistently pushed the industry forward and improved experiences for fans, making it easier than ever to discover events, find the perfect seats, and enjoy unforgettable live entertainment, and we continue to lead the evolution of our industry today.

We're passionate about improving the fan experience and providing game-changing solutions for our clients, and we're always looking for smart, motivated people to help make it happen. Bring your enthusiasm, your big ideas, and your desire to team up with some of the best and brightest in technology and entertainment.

**The Role**

The Ticketing Operations Analyst – Product Operations coordinates cross-departmental product initiatives, ensuring effective stakeholder engagement in User Acceptance Testing and managing issue tracking with product teams under the supervision of the Manager, Ticketing Operations. The role also supports data cleansing efforts and fraud monitoring, collaborates on triage and escalation of product issues, and participates in after-hours on-call rotations as needed.

**What Will You Do?**

* Recruits, coordinates, and holds accountable the business stakeholders required to complete User Acceptance Testing (UAT) on new AXS products and features, working closely with the Product Owner and Project Managers.
* Assists with the evaluation and escalation of Global Triage bug tickets. Troubleshoots any reported issues and resolves or escalates as needed.
* Serves as overflow support to team members responsible for creating and validating fees, investigating fee variance tickets, and managing Apex user accounts.
* Assists with completing client and promoter requests for OTL sweeps, generating reports on problematic orders for clients, and coordinating the bulk cancellation of orders in violation of ticket limits.
* Participates in an on-call rotation with other department staff to assist with daily bulk refunds for rescheduled events and triaging emergency requests after hours and on weekends.
* Provides general and project-specific assistance as needed to the other Ticketing Operations staff under the supervision of the Manager, Ticketing Operations.

**What Will You Bring?**

* BA/BS Degree in Computer Science, Business Administration, or Marketing major preferred.
* 2-4 years of significant experience in live event ticketing and/or ticketing software administration may be substituted for equivalent education depending on the nature of the work experience.
* Ability to independently manage complex projects
* Familiarity with software testing protocols
* Excel experience required, including a familiarity with data parsing and vlookup functions
* Strong communication skills and the ability gracefully enforce accountability standards
* Ability to juggle multiple pressing priorities and meet aggressive deadlines
* Flexibility in adapting to rules and processes that frequently evolve

  

*At AXS, we are dedicated to building a diverse,* *inclusive* *and authentic workplace, so if* *you're* *excited about this role but* *can't* *"check every box**" in* *the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be the right candidate for this or other roles.*

  

**Pay Scale: $62,000 - $70,000**

**Bonus:** This position is eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements.

**Benefits: Full-time:** We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes: medical, dental and vision insurance, paid holidays, vacation and sick time, company paid basic life insurance, voluntary life insurance, parental leave, 401k Plan (with a current employer match of 3%), flexible spending and health savings account options, and wellness offerings. Currently, full time employees are eligible for these benefits on the first day of employment.

* **Employer does not offer work visa sponsorship for this position.**

  

**What's in it for You?**

* **Extraordinary People** – we're not kidding!
* **Meaningful Mission**– Helping revolutionize an industry and deliver better experiences for fans and clients around the world.
* **Development and Learning** – Opportunities for learning and leveling up through training and education reimbursement.
* **Community & Belonging** –A range of Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that foster connection, inclusion, and professional growth. Access to meaningful volunteer opportunities and community engagement programs to make a positive impact beyond the workplace.

  

**More about AXS**

AXS, a subsidiary of AEG, sells millions of tickets each year for 1600+ premier venues, sports teams, and event organizers across North America, Europe, Asia, Australia and New Zealand. Headquartered in Downtown Los Angeles, California, AXS employs more than 900 professionals in multiple locations worldwide. In each location you'll find a team of dedicated, diverse employees (we've dubbed ourselves "Fanatix") who create groundbreaking products and services in a fun, fast-paced environment.

To learn more about our culture and values, visit: https://solutions.axs.com/careers/

  

**More about AEG**

AEG brings music, sports, and live entertainment together to create moments people feel, share, and remember around the world. Each year, more than 100 million fans experience over 13,000 live events across five continents, from iconic concerts and major festivals to championship-level sports and entertainment destinations.  
Powered by a passion for live experiences and the people behind them, we connect artists, teams, fans, and communities through world-class venues, events, and partnerships that shape culture and bring people together.  
Headquartered in Los Angeles, AEG is driven by creativity, innovation, and purpose. If you're ready to do work that show

jobs.title: Stagiaire Data Analyst Warehouse (H/F)
jobs.description:
**Pourquoi a-t-on besoin de vous ?**

Dans le cadre de la transformation digitale, de ses opérations logistiques et du déploiement de nouvelles solutions ERP et EWM au sein de Saint-Gobain Glass, nous recherchons un(e) stagiaire Data Analyst pour accompagner l'évolution de notre environnement décisionnel Warehouse.

Au sein de l'équipe Data & Supply Chain, vous contribuerez à la migration, à la structuration et à la valorisation des données logistiques afin de fournir des reportings fiables et pertinents pour les équipes opérationnelles.

**Missions principales**

* Cartographier, migrer et mettre à jour les modèles de données et dashboards Warehouse entre les environnements Legacy et les nouvelles solutions ERP/EWM, en garantissant la cohérence des KPI et la qualité des données.
* Participer à la conception, au développement et à l'amélioration continue des reportings Warehouse sous Databricks et MicroStrategy (MSTR).
* Documenter les modèles de données, les règles de transformation et les indicateurs de performance associés.

  
**Ce poste est-il fait pour vous ?**

**Profil recherché**

* Étudiant(e) en Bac+4 / Bac+5 (École d'ingénieur, Master en Data, Informatique, Business Intelligence, Statistiques ou équivalent).
* Connaissances en SQL seraient un plus.
* Intérêt pour la Supply Chain, l'industrie et les environnements Data modernes.
* Esprit analytique, rigueur et capacité à travailler en autonomie.
* Bon niveau d'anglais professionnel.

**Compétences techniques appréciées**

* SQL
* Databricks
* MicroStrategy (MSTR)
* Excel
* Outils de Data Visualization
* Python
* Concepts de Business Intelligence et de Data Warehousing

**Ce que vous apprendrez**

* Participer à un programme majeur de transformation ERP/EWM dans un contexte international.
* Comprendre les enjeux de qualité, de structuration et de gouvernance des données.
* Concevoir et faire évoluer des tableaux de bord à destination des métiers de la Supply Chain.
* Travailler avec des technologies Data modernes telles que Databricks et MicroStrategy.
* Collaborer avec les équipes métier, Supply Chain et IT dans un environnement industriel exigeant.

  
**Pour être sûr de ne rien oublier**

Saint-Gobain est une maison accueillante, sûre et ouverte sur le monde, dans laquelle on entre pour un parcours.

jobs.title: Commercial Program Manager
jobs.description:
At IEM, we're not just building innovative electrical distribution systems, we're shaping the future. IEM is dedicated to delivering world-class solutions for complex power needs. After 75 years, we continue to push the boundaries of what's possible. Whether you're an experienced professional or just starting out, you'll have the opportunity to contribute, grow, and make a lasting impact on industries that power the world's most dynamic markets.

**Location:** Fremont, CA

**Reports To:** Director Global Accounts Executive

**Salary Range:** $132,000-$200,000

**Position Summary:**

We are a rapidly expanding manufacturing company focused on delivering complex, high-volume solutions for leading enterprise customers. Our success is built on operational excellence, strategic partnerships, and an unwavering commitment to innovation and customer satisfaction. We are seeking a professional, proactive, and strategic **Commercial Program Manager** to lead and manage the partnership with one of our most critical enterprise customers.

The **Commercial Program Manager** is responsible for managing the full program lifecycle, ensuring alignment between customer demand and internal production capabilities. This role is accountable for aligning internal operations with client requirements, ensuring timely delivery, quality performance, and seamless execution across all phases of the program. The ideal candidate is a proactive, strategic thinker with strong program management experience and the ability to coordinate across diverse internal teams and external stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Proactively review and interpret customer forecasts to identify trends, anticipate demand shifts, and align supplier capacity and internal production schedules accordingly.
* Translate forecast data into actionable plans by working directly with production teams to coordinate build output and ensure readiness for deployment.
* Own the process for correcting purchase orders, reconciling discrepancies, and coordinating timely pricing updates between internal teams and the customer
* Respond quickly to quality and field service issues, coordinating internally to drive resolutions and minimize customer impact.
* Actively contribute to customer related projects and continuous improvement initiatives that increase efficiency and enhance customer satisfaction.
* Ensure program delivery aligns with customer service level agreements by constantly monitoring performance metrics and taking corrective action as needed.
* Take a data-driven approach to aligning inventory with forecasted demand and support planning for body of design, product phaseouts, and lifecycle transitions.
* Analyze volume trends and program data to inform decision-making, highlight risks, and support continuous improvement in delivery performance.
* Monitor inventory levels closely, perform flow analysis, and take corrective actions to prevent shortages or excess while maintaining alignment with customer demand.
* Foster a culture of team accountability and collaborative problem-solving across departments by setting clear expectations, following up on deliverables, and driving shared program goals forward.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in business, Engineering or related field (MBA or PMP certification a plus).
* 5+ years of program or project management experience in a manufacturing or enterprise client-facing role with annualized volume exceeding $10 million.
* Proven track record managing complex programs with multiple stakeholders across technical and business functions.
* Strong understanding of supply chain processes, inventory management, and demand planning.
* Experience with ERP and customer portal tools.
* Excellent organizational, analytical, and communication skills.
* Demonstrated ability to work under pressure, prioritize tasks, and drive results across functional boundaries.
* Comfortable managing ambiguity and adapting to a dynamic, high-growth environment.
* Exceptional interpersonal skills with a collaborative, team-first mentality.

**Why Join IEM**

At IEM, you'll join a team that powers some of the world's most ambitious projects. We're engineers, makers, and problem-solvers who thrive on tackling complex challenges and delivering solutions that keep industries moving forward. If you're driven, collaborative, and ready to make an impact, we'd love to hear from you. Your creativity and passion can help us achieve great things—come be part of the journey.

Learn more about IEM at https://www.iemfg.com

* Experience embedding shift-left security assessments (such as secure-by-design reviews, pen testing, or cryptographic modernization) into the product lifecycle, and relevant certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM, CCSP).

**About the job**
-----------------

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.

The Google Distributed Cloud (GDC) TPM Team leads cross-functional engineering execution for Google's sovereign, air-gapped (GDCag), and connected (GDCc) edge cloud platforms serving public sector, defense, intelligence, and regulated enterprise customers globally.

As the Security and Compliance Technical Program Manager (TPM) across GDCag and GDCc, you will partner with Security Engineering, Product Management, Operable Component (OC) Tech Leads, and Cloud CISO/Compliance teams to drive GDC's security and accreditation roadmap. You will lead high-priority horizontal security mandates—including Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) Migration (CNSA 2.0 / NIST SP 800-208), continuous vulnerability and CVE remediation SLAs, and automated SecAssure compliance controls—while orchestrating US Government (IL5/IL6, FedRAMP High, NIAP) and commercial/sovereign regulatory certifications (ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI-DSS) from architectural scoping through audit readiness and release sign-off.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $192000 - $278000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**

* Own and drive cross-functional security and compliance roadmaps across GDC Air-Gapped (GDCag), GDC Connected (GDCc), and Gemini on GDC Connected (GGC) to unlock sovereign, defense, and regulated enterprise accreditations (IL5/IL6, FedRAMP, FIPS).

jobs.title: Compliance Assurance Program Manager
jobs.description:
The global privacy regulatory landscape is not static, and the product and technical landscape at Meta changes multiple times daily to continue to meet and meet the needs of our more than 3.5 billion daily users on our platform. The Compliance Assurance Program Manager (CAPM) works at the center of privacy regulation, legal, business, product, and engineering to put our users' privacy at the center of everything we do.The Exam & Audit (E&A) team, part of Meta's Regulatory Compliance Program (RCP), manages Meta's regulatory examination and audit engagements. E&A connects internal stakeholders with external assessors and regulators. Its work includes delivering external assessor testing on time and at quality, defending the program's position on findings, and driving remediation of identified gaps. As the second line of defense, E&A also gives compliance advice and independent oversight of Meta's privacy safeguards. It challenges their design and effectiveness so that compliance becomes a catalyst for trusted, responsible product growth rather than a constraint.This role sits in the Third Party Risk Management (TPRM) domain. TPRM covers the safeguards that govern how third parties (developers, partners, vendors and service providers) access, use and protect Meta user data. The CAPM will be the second-line partner for these safeguards and will lead their readiness for independent assessment.We are looking for an individual contributor who brings audit, risk, and privacy expertise to serve as a trusted second-line advisor and assessment lead for third-party safeguards. As well as an individual contributor who tackles privacy complexities head-on, to help design and build an comprehensive privacy compliance program, while keeping our users and their privacy at the forefront of everything that we do.  
  
  

### **Compliance Assurance Program Manager Responsibilities:**

* Serve as the second-line compliance partner for TPRM safeguards across the whole third-party lifecycle: onboarding and due diligence, contract and platform terms, data access and API permissions, ongoing monitoring, enforcement, and offboarding and data deletion
* Lead FTC Consent Order Assessment readiness for assigned TPRM safeguards: coordinate assessor requests, review populations, samples and evidence, and own response narratives through to delivery
* Support Meta's commitment to protect users' privacy by enabling and advising privacy domains to navigate the complex landscape of global and data privacy regulations
* Advise on how new third-party integrations and platform capabilities affect Meta's privacy posture, and safeguards/controls
* Provide independent oversight to proactively identify issues, ensure visibility, and help prioritize remediation efforts within assigned safeguards/domains, acting as a key escalation point and advocate for risk mitigation
* Develop long-term objectives of how we will evolve our privacy program operating model with well-documented roadmaps, goals, and objectives while delivering on immediate priorities

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of experience in Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC), internal or external audit, or risk management, including third-party or vendor risk management, data privacy, or security
* 2+ years of experience delivering technical programs or products from inception to delivery across organizations
* Working knowledge of privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA) and third-party risk frameworks or standards (e.g., NIST, ISO 27001/27036, SOC 2)
* Prior experience working with program management either directly in product or engineering coupled with ITGC experience

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience using AI or automation to scale compliance testing, evidence review, and/or reporting
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience designing, operating, or assessing platform safeguards or API governance controls, such as developer access permissions and scopes, app review, data-use restrictions, rate limiting, or monitoring third-party data access
* Experience with regulatory consent orders or decrees (e.g., FTC Consent Order), especially provisions covering third parties
* Experience designing, implementing, and maintaining scalable global compliance operations
* Experience managing and directing contingent workers and contractors who specialize in privacy and security program management
* Design thinking process improvement experience leveraging creativity and structure to solve complex problems while putting the user first
* Experience in a leadership capacity influencing stakeholders and engineers
* Experience working in a technical environment and prior cross-group collaboration experience
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in a related discipline or equivalent practical experience
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.  
  
  

Meta is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity

jobs.title: Customer Deployment Manager
jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, USA
jobs.description:
**About Endra**

Every building is designed twice. The architect shapes what you see. MEP engineers design everything that makes it work: the power, air and water behind every hospital, data centre and home. It's a $150 billion industry still run on manual work and decades-old tools, and it's running out of engineers just as the world needs more buildings than ever.

We're building the platform that changes that. Endra's takes over the repetitive work so engineers can do what they're trained for: judgment and design. Some of the world's most respected engineering firms, including AtkinsRéalis, Ramboll, Buro Happold, Hoare Lea, Tetra Tech, AFRY and Rejlers, already build with us.

Since 2024, we've raised $75 million from Andreessen Horowitz, Notion Capital and Norrsken VC, and grown into a team across Stockholm, Zurich, London, New York and San Francisco. We're early, moving fast and setting out to change how the world's buildings get designed.

We're looking for people who care deeply about their craft, take ownership of complex problems, push us to think bigger, and are driven to create something with lasting impact.

**About the role**

For us, a signed contract is the starting line. The moment a customer signs, Customer Deployment takes over, and our job is to make Endra the way their engineers actually work as soon as possible.

As Customer Deployment Manager, you'll own that journey for some of our most important customers: large engineering consultancies with many offices, hundreds of engineers, and a long list of stakeholders who all need to say yes. You'll be the project lead for each rollout. You set up the structure, drive adoption, clear the roadblocks, and make the value impossible to miss.

You'll work hand in hand with our product specialists who are MEP engineers: they bring the MEP depth, you bring the structure and the commercial lens. Together you'll help engineers who have worked the same way for decades adopt a new one.

**What you'll do**.

* **Own onboarding and rollout.** Lead on-site and remote onboarding with our product specialists so MEP engineers get up and running fast and deliver real results using Endra on their very first project. You own the plan and the milestones, and you keep every stakeholder moving.
* **Work every stakeholder.** Cover everyone from the CEO and heads of discipline to BIM managers, IT and the engineers on the project. Keep them involved at the right moments, and turn early users into champions who train their colleagues.
* **Measure and report the wins.** Agree on success criteria with each customer, track adoption and account health, and act on risk early. Turn the results into clear wins for their leadership and for Endra.
* **Clear the roadblocks.** Spot what's stalling early, whether it's technical, organizational, or a skeptical team. Bring in the right people and see it through.
* **Find the next opportunity.** Uncover new teams, offices and use cases, and support account managers in further growing the customer accounts.
* **Shape the product.** Bring structured insight from the field to product and engineering, so what we build next is what customers need.
* **Build the playbook.** Our deployment function is young. You'll define how Endra rolls out, measures and reports, and set the standard the team scales on.

**Who you are**

* You've run or played a key role in enterprise software rollouts, with 3–5 years of client-facing experience in customer success, implementation or management consulting, ideally in a complex, expert-driven industry.
* You've driven change management before and know that getting a large organization onto new technology is as much about people as about software.
* You're structured and organized, and you stay calm when there are many moving parts.
* You take ownership, and your track record shows it in results delivered and responsibilities that grew.
* You have commercial instinct. You know adoption drives renewal and expansion, and you think about the customer's business case, not only usage numbers.
* You're an excellent communicator, in writing and in the room, and a team player who makes the people around you better.
* You’re comfortable building as you go, improving a playbook rather than just following it.

**How we think and work**

* Less is more: We simplify and ship smaller, fast.
* Build the right things: We listen carefully and build what users actually need.
* Velocity & Quality: We build things that last, but we don’t perfect them forever.
* Trust & Collaboration: Strong opinions, loosely held.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary and equity.
* Employee-friendly equity terms.
* Private health insurance.
* Regular team events and off-sites.
* An inspiring, ambitious, and global work environment.

**Ready to move the needle?**

Do you feel this is your opportunity to do your most meaningful work and reshape an entire industry? Let's talk!

Compensation Range: $140K - $190K

jobs.title: Customer Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
**About Xsight Labs**

Xsight Labs is a leading fabless semiconductor company delivering end-to-end connectivity solutions for cloud service providers, hyperscale data center networks, and edge applications. As a result of Xsight’s industry-leading products and technology, we are turning heads in the industry and looking to grow our team.

Xsight’s E1 DPU is the world’s first 800G DPU, built around a many-core on-path CPU fabric and hardware accelerators. Together with a standards-based SW development model, this architecture delivers industry-leading performance while oLering greater ease-of-programmability compared to traditional DPUs.

The company’s X2 family of fully programmable data center switches, ranging from 3.2T to 12.8T, provide application-optimized switching for top-of-rack deployments, data center fabrics, high-performance computing (HPC), and AI/ML clusters. Together, these products accelerate the high-performance network solutions of tomorrow.

**Job Description**:

Reporting to the Director of Customer Engineering, the Technical Program Manager (TPM) is the operational engine of our customer engagements. This is not a standard project management role; it requires a process-oriented leader who can create order out of the "chaos" of multiple simultaneous threads. You will navigate the internal development cycles of Hyperscalers and other Tier-1 customers to ensure our silicon and software are integrated at scale, from concept to production.

**Responsibilities will include**, but are not limited to:

* Operational Orchestration: Create order and clear processes out of complex, competing technical threads to ensure customer program success.
* Hyperscale Alignment: Act as the internal expert on Hyperscaler development cycles, ensuring Xsight’s delivery aligns with customer-specific processes and milestones.
* Program Lifecycle Leadership: Manage customer projects through the entire lifecycle—from initial concept and implementation to production and massivescale deployment.
* Cross-Functional Advocacy: Balance the "Voice of the Customer" with Xsight's internal resource needs, collaborating with PLM, Sales, and R&D to resolve issues.
* High-Velocity Execution: Drive technical progress at an extreme velocity, managing multiple customer projects with often conflicting priorities.
* Executive Presence: Represent Xsight in high-stakes technical meetings, using strong influence and communication skills to drive alignment across global teams.

  
Requirements:  
  

Qualifications

* Education: B.S. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Industry Experience: 10+ years in the semiconductor or networking market (15+ years preferred), with deep knowledge of cloud architectures and hyperscale internal workings.
* Strong understanding of data-center networking, DPU/SmartNIC trends, including specific experience with programmable architectures.
* Solid knowledge of fundamental technologies such as Ethernet networking, storage, and data center infrastructure and specifically in the semiconductor market.
* Familiarity with high-performance data center technologies including RDMA, DPDK, SPDK, NVMe, Cloud Native, Linux, SONiC, DASH and P4.
* Velocity & Agility: Proven ability to work independently in a dynamic, high-velocity startup environment where priorities can shift rapidly.
* Interpersonal Leadership: People-oriented with an executive presence and a demonstrated ability to influence others without direct authority.

• Direct customer interaction experience, face-to-face and remote. • Customer service-oriented mindset and strong communication skills, including fluency in English (written and verbal) and good listening skills.

* Ability to work independently and as part of a team. Xsight is a collaborative teamoriented environment. Regardless of level, everyone at Xsight is an individual contributor that contributes to the greater success of the company.
* Ability to travel globally is required.
* Direct experience managing programs for major cloud providers (e.g., AWS, Google, Microsoft, Meta, Oracle) is a preferred diLerentiator.

Location: USA, Northern California Bay Area preferred

Akima Logistics Services (ALS), an Akima company, is not just another federal logistics contractor. As an Alaska Native Corporation (ANC), our mission and purpose extend beyond our exciting federal projects as we support our shareholder communities in Alaska.

new_jobs.description:
**Job Requirements**  

**SUMMARY**
===========

The Disney DTC Sports & ESPN Analytics team is seeking a Senior Data Analyst who will be an exceptional addition to our team. You will be responsible for turning data into information, information into insights, and insights into key business decisions that steer the strategic direction of ESPN's direct-to-consumer product strategy. The right person for this role has exceptional analytical capabilities, thrives in a fast-paced environment, loves problem-solving, is a good communicator, and is passionate about high quality digital product experiences.

You will play a key role in building out ESPN's product analytics function from the ground up, serving as a dedicated point of contact and thought partner for the ESPN product and product engineering teams. You will lead the foundational work streams for ESPN app measurement: standing up a governed, centralized source of truth for ESPN app performance metrics — canonical definitions, consistent logic, and numbers the business can align on — and building the self-serve tooling that lets stakeholders not only see that a KPI moved, but locate what drove the movement. You will also be the experimentation partner to the product organization, shaping how ESPN app features are tested and how those results are read.

This role is hands-on and technical. You will design and maintain the aggregation logic and metric tables that sit underneath executive reporting, and you will be expected to defend the numbers you publish — including the measurement caveats that travel with them.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Own and evolve the source-of-truth metric layer for ESPN app performance — headline KPIs (DAU, time spent, watch minutes), their definitions, their dimensional breakouts, and the documented caveats that accompany each
* Design and maintain pre-aggregated metric tables and serving views in Snowflake, and the scheduled pipelines that refresh them, ensuring metrics are correct at every level of aggregation
* Build the monitoring and decomposition logic that identifies when a KPI movement is real and where it is concentrated — baselines, significance thresholds, contribution ranking, and volume-versus-mix splits
* Distinguish genuine behavioral movements from measurement artifacts and instrumentation breakage, and partner with product engineering to close the analytics QA gap on client releases
* Build dashboards and self-serve tooling in Looker that reduce stakeholder reliance on ad-hoc analyst pulls
* Conduct analyses using SQL and Python to access and manipulate multivariate product and behavioral data, and ideate new metrics and analytical approaches for in-app user behavior
* Partner with product and engineering on experimentation end-to-end — translating a product question into a testable hypothesis, selecting primary and guardrail metrics, sizing and powering the test, validating assignment and exposure, analyzing the readout, and diagnosing what happened when a test misbehaves or reads flat
* Reconcile ESPN app metrics across teams and systems, and drive alignment on definitions with Research, Data Product, and data engineering partners
* Serve as a dedicated point of contact and thought partner for ESPN product and product engineering teams, taking projects end-to-end from vague business need to socialized insight
* Communicate results through compelling data storytelling to product leadership and the broader ESPN business

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**

* Degree in an analytical area such as Mathematics, Statistics, Operations Research, Computer Science, Economics, or equivalent practical experience
* 5+ years of relevant work experience in analytics, product analytics, and/or business intelligence
* Advanced SQL — able to read and write complex analytical queries, and to reason about correctness of aggregation logic (for example, why a distinct-count metric cannot be summed across segments)
* Working proficiency in Python for data manipulation, analysis, and pipeline work
* Practical understanding of data warehousing and dimensional modeling — how metric tables are structured, refreshed, and served to downstream consumers
* Applied statistical judgment: constructing baselines, assessing whether a change is meaningful versus noise, and handling seasonality and day-of-week effects
* Hands-on product experimentation experience — designing and executing A/B and multivariate tests, analyzing results (significance, confidence intervals, minimum detectable effect, guardrail metrics), and diagnosing common failure modes such as sample ratio mismatch, assignment or exposure leakage, interaction effects, and novelty decay
* Experience with data visualization tools (Looker, Tableau, or equivalent) coupled with strong storytelling skills for technical and non-technical audiences
* Experience taking vague requirements and manipulating them into polished final products
* Strong and effective communication and presentation skills

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Hands-on experience with digital clickstream or behavioral analytics data (Adobe Analytics, Amplitude, or similar), including its identity and measurement limitations
* Experience with Databricks, PySpark, or comparable large-scale data processing
* Experience establishing metric governance — canonical definitions, reconciliation across teams, and change management on metric logic
* Experience with an experimentation platform (Optimizely, Statsig, Amplitude Experiment, or in-house) and with scaling experimentation practice across product teams
* Familiarity with identity resolution across web, app, and connected TV, and the practical consequences of cookie-based measurement
* Prior experience in Sports or Media/Entertainment

**Description**

Leidos is seeking a Senior Supply Chain Risk Management Threat Intelligence Analyst to provide advanced, high-level technical and analytical support to the FAA’s Counterintelligence (CI) Supply Chain Risk Management (SCRM) program. The program is responsible for identifying, assessing, and mitigating foreign intelligence, nation-state, and cybersecurity threats to the FAA’s supply chain, critical infrastructure, and enterprise networks. Embedded as a senior leader within a 4-person team, this position focuses on threat landscapes, adversarial intent, and geopolitical vulnerability modeling. Providing independent, authoritative all-source intelligence analysis, the senior analyst designs analytic methodologies using Open Source Intelligence (OSINT) and corporate registries to uncover hidden Foreign Ownership, Control, or Influence (FOCI), technology transfer risks, and strategic threat trends targeting the aviation industrial base. This role oversees the evaluation of physical, technical, and personnel vulnerabilities, including sophisticated hardware/firmware threats and insider risks, to produce exquisite intelligence briefings that guide FAA executive leadership and empower the broader SCRM framework.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Conduct proactive threat analysis of foreign suppliers, third-party software developers, and hardware manufacturers to identify nation-state activity and strategic threat trends targeting the FAA.
* Utilize OSINT and corporate registries to screen prospective FAA vendors and evaluate the supply chain for Foreign Ownership, Control, or Influence (FOCI) indicators, foreign partnerships, and technology transfer threats.
* Monitor specialized threat feeds, nation-state activities, and geopolitical shifts to identify, evaluate, and mitigate strategic supply chain risks to the FAA.
* Support the FAA Insider Risk Program by identifying and analyzing personnel concerns, anomalous vendor behaviors, and internal vulnerabilities.
* Evaluate threat vectors including malicious hardware or software modifications, supply chain transit interdiction, and counterfeit electronic components.
* Synthesize complex data to produce clear, actionable Supplier Threat Profiles, Country Risk Profiles, link-analysis diagrams, and timely threat alerts/advisories for FAA program managers, technical teams, and executive decision-makers.
* Translate highly complex counterintelligence findings, technical hardware/software vulnerabilities, and macroeconomic geopolitical risks into exquisite intelligence briefings, dashboards, and executive decision packages tailored specifically for senior FAA leadership.
* Formulate performance metrics and program reports for executive leadership.
* Maintain critical operational and collaborative relationships with external stakeholders, including the FAA Chief Information Officer (CIO), Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA), Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI), Department of Homeland Security (DHS), and the broader Intelligence Community (IC).
* Coordinate and facilitate SCRM training and awareness campaigns for acquisition personnel and program offices.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Citizenship: U.S. Citizenship required.
* Clearance: Active Top Secret/SCI clearance is required.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Supply Chain, Intelligence Studies, National Security, Logistics, Data Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline. (Equivalent professional experience or specialized military/federal training may be substituted).
* Experience: 12+ years of professional experience as an Intelligence Analyst (All-Source, Cyber, Counterintelligence, or Open-Source Intelligence) or senior-level experience in third-party risk management (TPRM), Cyber Supply Chain Risk Management (C-SCRM), technical risk assessments, IT auditing, cybersecurity risk management, or infrastructure defense in a federal or highly regulated commercial environment.
* Analytical Capability: Work as a Subject Matter Expert in Supply Chain Risk Management. Proven experience using corporate registries, commercial databases, and OSINT techniques to analyze corporate structures, trace components, and evaluate FOCI.
* Technical Skills: Proficiency with due diligence or corporate intelligence platforms (e.g., Sayari, Altana, Interos, Maltego) and/or data modeling.
* Communication Skills: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a proven track record of translating complex intelligence and technical risk data into clear, concise executive briefs and formal written reports for non-technical stakeholders and delivering briefing materials to C-suite or flag-level leadership.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Completion of formal military or federal intelligence training courses focusing on threat network analysis or open-source collection.
* High proficiency with advanced OSINT search techniques, corporate filing retrieval systems, and international trade/shipping databases.
* Familiarity with the acquisition frameworks and an understanding of how supply chain intelligence feeds into federal procurement lifecycles.
* Prior experience supporting threat intelligence or counterintelligence infrastructure defense missions specifically for critical infrastructure or a federal agency.

new_jobs.description:
Overview:

AMERICAN SYSTEMS, a **100% employee-owned** federal contractor, is seeking a **Data Steward and Data Analyst** to support mission-focused data integration efforts in **Arlington, VA**. You will help transform complex mission data into **secure, trusted, discoverable, and reusable data products** that support Government decision-making and operations.

The ideal candidate is a **collaborative, detail-oriented data professional** who can balance mission needs with sound **data governance** and security practices. You bring strong analytical judgment, communicate clearly with both technical and mission stakeholders, and take ownership of **solving complex data challenges in a dynamic, classified environment**.

**\*\*\* This job requisition is for potential upcoming work at AMERICAN SYSTEMS and does not represent a current opening. Qualified candidates will be contacted when the work/funding becomes available. \*\*\***

Responsibilities:

As a **Sr. Data Steward and Data Analyst** with AMERICAN SYSTEMS, you will:

* Analyze mission data sources and requests, including **format, volume, sensitivity, classification, ownership, authoritative source, consumers, and operational dependencies**.
* Develop and maintain **data-source profiles**, including schemas, data dictionaries, metadata, lineage, quality rules, access tags, catalog entries, and acceptance criteria.
* Support data governance and data-management activities that improve **data discoverability, reuse, controlled sharing, interoperability, and mission usability**.
* Support the design, analysis, and implementation of data-management solutions, including **data modeling, relational database analysis, metadata repositories, data mapping, and transformational analysis**.
* Partner with Government stakeholders, data owners, software teams, platform teams, security personnel, compliance stakeholders, and operations teams to validate data use and handling requirements.
* Document **classification, releasability, retention, audit, masking, and access-control** requirements for mission data.
* Support **attribute-based access control (ABAC)** implementation through attribute mapping, metadata tagging, controlled sharing, and secure data-product publication.
* Develop and maintain technical documentation, including **data architectures, interface control documents, source-to-target mappings, access-control plans, test plans, validation procedures, and runbooks**.
* Perform **data profiling, reconciliation, validation, anomaly identification, trend analysis, and data-quality assessments**.
* Define and track data-quality metrics, including **availability, completeness, timeliness, lineage accuracy, schema conformance, catalog readiness, and usability**.
* Support integration and test activities by validating **data movement, schema implementation, metadata tagging, access controls, quality rules, and audit requirements**.
* Identify and recommend practical improvements related to **data quality, standardization, discoverability, reuse, and operational performance**.
* Prepare clear technical analyses, data profiles, test results, and stakeholder-ready deliverables.

Qualifications:

* **Active Top Secret security clearance** with **SCI** and **SAP eligibility**.
* Bachelor’s degree in **data science, information systems, computer science, analytics, statistics, engineering, or a related technical discipline**.
* **5 to 7 years of related experience** in data analysis, data stewardship, data governance, database analysis, data integration, database development, or a related technical field.
* Current **DoD 8140 IAT Level II baseline certification**, such as **CompTIA Security+ CE**, or another qualifying IAT Level II certification.
* **Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst Associate**, **Tableau certification**, or an equivalent **data analytics certification**.
* Experience documenting **data sources, schemas, data dictionaries, metadata, lineage, data-quality rules, catalog entries, data tags, and acceptance criteria**.
* Experience working with **structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data**.
* Experience with **SQL**, relational databases, data profiling, data-quality analysis, metadata management, source-to-target mapping, and dashboards.
* Working knowledge of **data governance, lifecycle management, classification handling, access controls, releasability, retention, audit requirements, and secure data sharing**.
* Familiarity with **ABAC**, attribute mapping, metadata tagging, controlled sharing, and data-masking concepts.
* Ability to work independently, develop sound approaches to assigned work, and deliver practical solutions to complex data challenges.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

**Helpful Qualifications**

* **DAMA CDMP Associate** certification, or an equivalent **data management or data governance certification**.
* Experience supporting **enterprise data products** or mission data integration workflows.
* Experience with SQL, data profiling, data quality analysis, data dictionaries, metadata management, source-to-target mapping, dashboards, and relational databases

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

US: $192000 - $278000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

--------------------

* Own and drive cross-functional security and compliance roadmaps across GDC Air-Gapped (GDCag), GDC Connected (GDCc), and Gemini on GDC Connected (GGC) to unlock sovereign, defense, and regulated enterprise accreditations (IL5/IL6, FedRAMP, FIPS).

new_jobs.title: Business & Financial Operations Analyst - AIML
new_jobs.description:
Summary
  
  
The SWE Ops Infrastructure & Planning team is seeking an analytical, proactive, and collaborative Business & Financial Operations Analyst to maintain operational rigor and drive standardization across the AI team within the SWE organization. In this role, you will drive requisition management, steer quarterly fiscal planning activities, and partner closely with engineering, research, finance, EPMs, and cross-functional leadership. You will serve as a key operational partner in budget forecasting, and vendor procurement, delivering the insights, processes, and frameworks that empower leaders to optimize resource allocation, make informed decisions, and execute seamlessly against our highest priorities.
  
  
Description
  
  
The SWE Ops Infrastructure & Planning team is committed to fostering a culture of technical excellence and operational discipline. As our research and engineering initiatives grow in scale and complexity, we are looking for an analyst who thrives in bringing structure to ambiguity, connecting the bigger picture to operational execution, and bringing decision-ready insights to various levels of leadership. The ideal candidate pairs strong project management acumen and deep analytical capability with exceptional interpersonal skills. You will drive alignment across machine learning scientists, engineering DRIs, finance, and cross-functional partners—championing clarity, accountability, and continuous improvement while ensuring disciplined stewardship of our resources through proactive forecasting and vendor management. You embody a passion to fight for excellence (striving for exceptional outcomes without settling) and the foresight to see around corners (anticipating long-term organizational, technological, and strategic trajectories).
  
  
Minimum Qualifications  
  
  

* 5+ years of business operations, financial planning & analysis, strategy & operations experience within a high-tech or software engineering environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in an analytical or quantitative discipline (such as Business, Finance, Operations, Supply Chain), or equivalent practical experience.
* Proven track record managing the end-to-end Purchase Requisition (PR) to Purchase Order (PO) lifecycle—including vendor onboarding, scoping alignment, and proactive cross-functional chasing.
* Solid grasp of core financial treatment principles: CapEx vs. OpEx, prepaid assets, accruals, amortization schedules, and milestone-based billing.
* Demonstrated ability to track, analyze, and reconcile budget actuals vs. forecasts, identifying variances and driving corrective actions before quarter-end.
* Exceptional executive communication skills: ability to distill complex procurement timelines and financial figures into crisp, high-level narratives and executive summaries.
* Superior written and verbal communication skills, with proven ability to distill complex technical/operational information into clear, executive-ready presentations and memos.

  
  
  
Preferred Qualifications  
  
  

* CPA or MBA
* Experience working with data licensing, or technical vendor contracts.
* Direct experience partnering with or supporting Machine Learning, AI, or R&D research teams.
* Familiarity with data analysis, querying, and visualization tools (e.g., SQL, Excel, Tableau) to evaluate organizational metrics and build automated reporting.
* A natural curiosity for AI/ML technologies and how strategic investments fuel model development.

The base pay range for this role is between $92,706 and $172,700 annualized, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.
